        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__collaborative_reasoning",
          "description": "Multi-perspective collaborative problem solving with diverse personas and structured contributions.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "topic": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The central topic or problem being addressed in the collaborative session."
              },
              "personas": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the persona."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the persona (e.g., 'Devil's Advocate', 'Chief Technology Officer')."
                    },
                    "expertise": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of the persona's areas of expertise (e.g., 'cybersecurity', 'user experience')."
                    },
                    "background": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The background and context of the persona, informing their perspective."
                    },
                    "perspective": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The unique viewpoint or lens this persona brings to the discussion."
                    },
                    "biases": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of potential cognitive biases this persona may have (e.g., 'Confirmation Bias', 'Optimism Bias')."
                    },
                    "communication": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "style": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The communication style of the persona (e.g., 'Socratic', 'data-driven', 'narrative-focused')."
                        },
                        "tone": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The communication tone of the persona (e.g., 'skeptical', 'supportive', 'formal')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "style",
                        "tone"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "The communication style and tone of the persona."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "id",
                    "name",
                    "expertise",
                    "background",
                    "perspective",
                    "biases",
                    "communication"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The set of diverse personas participating in the reasoning process."
              },
              "contributions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "personaId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the persona making the contribution."
                    },
                    "content": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The substance of the contribution, such as an idea, question, or piece of evidence."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "observation",
                        "question",
                        "insight",
                        "concern",
                        "suggestion",
                        "challenge",
                        "synthesis"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of contribution, which frames its intent."
                    },
                    "confidence": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the validity or importance of the contribution.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "referenceIds": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of IDs of other contributions this one builds upon, challenges, or refers to."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "personaId",
                    "content",
                    "type",
                    "confidence"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A log of all contributions made during the session."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "problem-definition",
                  "ideation",
                  "critique",
                  "integration",
                  "decision",
                  "reflection"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the collaborative reasoning process, guiding the nature of contributions."
              },
              "activePersonaId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The ID of the persona who is currently expected to contribute."
              },
              "nextPersonaId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The ID of the persona designated to contribute next, guiding the conversation flow."
              },
              "consensusPoints": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of key points or decisions on which all personas have reached agreement."
              },
              "disagreements": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "topic": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific topic or point of contention."
                    },
                    "positions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "personaId": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "The ID of the persona advocating for this position."
                          },
                          "position": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "A clear statement of the position taken in the disagreement."
                          },
                          "arguments": {
                            "type": "array",
                            "items": {
                              "type": "string"
                            },
                            "description": "The key arguments and evidence supporting this position."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "personaId",
                          "position",
                          "arguments"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "The different positions taken by personas in the disagreement."
                    },
                    "resolution": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "consensus",
                            "compromise",
                            "integration",
                            "tabled"
                          ],
                          "description": "The method by which the disagreement was resolved."
                        },
                        "description": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "A summary of the resolution and the reasoning behind it."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "type",
                        "description"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "The outcome of the attempt to resolve the disagreement."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [

        {

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__decision_framework",
          "description": "Structured decision analysis and rational choice frameworks for complex decisions.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "decisionStatement": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and concise statement of the decision to be made."
              },
              "options": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",

                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the decision option."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",

                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the decision option."

                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of the options being considered."

              "criteria": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",

                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "weight": {
                      "type": "number",

                      "minimum": 0,

                    },
                    "evaluationMethod": {
                      "type": "string",

                  "additionalProperties": false
                },

                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of stakeholders involved in the decision."
              },

                "type": "array",

                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of constraints on the decision."

              "possibleOutcomes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the possible outcome."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the possible outcome."
                    },
                    "probability": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The probability of this outcome occurring (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "value": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The value of this outcome."
                    },
                    "optionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the option this outcome is associated with."
                    },
                    "confidenceInEstimate": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the probability and value estimates.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "probability",
                    "value",
                    "optionId",
                    "confidenceInEstimate"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of possible outcomes for the decision."
              },
              "criteriaEvaluations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "criterionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the criterion being evaluated."
                    },
                    "optionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the option being evaluated against the criterion."
                    },
                    "score": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The score of the option against the criterion (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "justification": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The justification for the score."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "criterionId",
                    "optionId",
                    "score",
                    "justification"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of evaluations of the options against the criteria."
              },
              "informationGaps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A description of the information gap."
                    },
                    "impact": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The potential impact of this information gap on the decision (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "researchMethod": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The method for researching and filling this information gap."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "impact",
                    "researchMethod"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of information gaps that need to be filled."
              },
              "analysisType": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "expected-utility",
                  "multi-criteria",
                  "maximin",
                  "minimax-regret",
                  "satisficing"
                ],
                "description": "The type of analysis to be performed."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "problem-definition",
                  "options",
                  "criteria",
                  "evaluation",
                  "analysis",
                  "recommendation"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the decision-making process."
              },
              "recommendation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final recommendation."
              },
              "sensitivityInsights": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of insights from sensitivity analysis."
              },
              "expectedValues": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "number"
                },
                "description": "A record of the expected values for each option."
              },
              "multiCriteriaScores": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "number"
                },
                "description": "A record of the multi-criteria scores for each option."
              },
              "decisionId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this decision."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this decision-making process."
              },
              "suggestedNextStage": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The suggested next stage in the decision-making process."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another stage is needed."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "decisionStatement",
              "options",
              "analysisType",
              "stage",
              "decisionId",
              "iteration",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__domain_modeling",
          "description": "Creating and refining conceptual models of a domain, including entities, relationships, and rules.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "domainName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the domain being modeled."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A detailed description of the domain."
              },
              "modelingId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this modeling session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this modeling session."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "analysis",
                  "conceptual",
                  "logical",
                  "physical",
                  "validation",
                  "refinement"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the modeling process."
              },
              "entities": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the entity."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the entity."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the entity's purpose and role."
                    },
                    "attributes": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of data attributes associated with the entity."
                    },
                    "behaviors": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of behaviors or operations the entity can perform."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of rules or constraints that apply to this entity."
                    },
                    "invariants": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of conditions that must always be true for this entity."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "attributes"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all entities in the domain."
              },
              "relationships": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the relationship."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the relationship."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "one-to-one",
                        "one-to-many",
                        "many-to-many",
                        "inheritance",
                        "composition",
                        "aggregation",
                        "dependency"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of relationship between entities."
                    },
                    "sourceEntity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the source entity in the relationship."
                    },
                    "targetEntity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the target entity in the relationship."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the relationship."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of rules or constraints that apply to this relationship."
                    },
                    "cardinality": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The cardinality of the relationship (e.g., '1..*')."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "type",
                    "sourceEntity",
                    "targetEntity",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all relationships between entities."
              },
              "domainRules": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the domain rule."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "business-rule",
                        "validation-rule",
                        "constraint",
                        "invariant",
                        "axiom"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "entities": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of entities to which this rule applies."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that must be met for the rule to apply."
                    },
                    "consequence": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The consequence of the rule being met."
                    },
                    "priority": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high",
                        "critical"
                      ],
                      "description": "The priority of the domain rule."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "type",
                    "entities",
                    "condition"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all domain rules."
              },
              "boundaries": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The name of the bounded context."
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A description of the bounded context."
                  },
                  "includedEntities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of entities included in this bounded context."
                  },
                  "excludedConcepts": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of concepts explicitly excluded from this bounded context."
                  },
                  "interfaces": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of interfaces this bounded context exposes."
                  },
                  "responsibilities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of responsibilities of this bounded context."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "name",
                  "description",
                  "includedEntities"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The bounded context of the domain."
              },
              "assumptions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of assumptions made during the modeling process."
              },
              "stakeholders": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of stakeholders involved in the modeling process."
              },
              "useCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of use cases for the domain."
              },
              "modelValidation": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "completeness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the completeness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "consistency": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the consistency of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "correctness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the correctness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "issues": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of identified issues with the model."
                  },
                  "suggestions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of suggestions for improving the model."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "completeness",
                  "consistency",
                  "correctness"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Validation results for the model."
              },
              "abstractionLevel": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "high",
                  "medium",
                  "low"
                ],
                "description": "The level of abstraction of the model."
              },
              "paradigm": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "object-oriented",
                  "relational",
                  "functional",
                  "event-driven",
                  "service-oriented",
                  "domain-driven"
                ],
                "description": "The modeling paradigm used."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another modeling stage is required."
              },
              "suggestedNextStage": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The suggested next stage in the modeling process."
              },
              "modelingNotes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of notes related to the modeling process."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "domainName",
              "description",
              "modelingId",
              "iteration",
              "stage",
              "entities",
              "abstractionLevel",
              "paradigm",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__mental_model",
          "description": "Tool for creating and analyzing mental models to understand complex problems and systems.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "modelName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the mental model being used (e.g., 'Second-Order Thinking', 'First Principles'). This helps categorize the analysis.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear, specific, and bounded description of the problem being analyzed. A good problem statement is crucial for effective model application. For example, 'How can we reduce user friction in our onboarding flow?' is better than 'Make the app better'.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "steps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A sequential, logical breakdown of how the mental model is applied. Each step should be a clear action or point of analysis, demonstrating the model's framework."
              },
              "reasoning": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The core logic behind the analysis. Explain *why* this model is appropriate for this problem and *how* the steps connect to the model's principles. This is crucial for evaluating the application's quality."
              },
              "conclusion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final, actionable insight or decision. It should be a direct synthesis of the preceding steps and reasoning."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "modelName",
              "problem"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__metacognitive_monitoring",
          "description": "Self-assessment of knowledge and reasoning quality for improved metacognition.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "task": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The overall task or problem being addressed."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "knowledge-assessment",
                  "planning",
                  "execution",
                  "monitoring",
                  "evaluation",
                  "reflection"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the metacognitive process."
              },
              "knowledgeAssessment": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "domain": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific domain or topic being assessed."
                  },
                  "knowledgeLevel": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "expert",
                      "proficient",
                      "familiar",
                      "basic",
                      "minimal",
                      "none"
                    ],
                    "description": "The self-assessed level of knowledge in this domain."
                  },
                  "confidenceScore": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed knowledge level.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "supportingEvidence": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Evidence to support the assessed knowledge level."
                  },
                  "knownLimitations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of known limitations or gaps in knowledge."
                  },
                  "relevantTrainingCutoff": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The date of the last relevant training or data cutoff."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "domain",
                  "knowledgeLevel",
                  "confidenceScore",
                  "supportingEvidence",
                  "knownLimitations"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "An assessment of the knowledge required for the task."
              },
              "claims": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "claim": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific claim being assessed."
                    },
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "fact",
                        "inference",
                        "speculation",
                        "uncertain"
                      ],
                      "description": "The assessed status of the claim."
                    },
                    "confidenceScore": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed status of the claim.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "evidenceBasis": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The evidence supporting the assessment of the claim."
                    },
                    "falsifiabilityCriteria": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Criteria that could be used to falsify the claim."
                    },
                    "alternativeInterpretations": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of alternative interpretations of the evidence."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "claim",
                    "status",
                    "confidenceScore",
                    "evidenceBasis"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of claims being made and assessed."
              },
              "reasoningSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "step": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific step in the reasoning process being assessed."
                    },
                    "potentialBiases": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of potential cognitive biases that may be influencing the reasoning."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of assumptions being made in this reasoning step."
                    },
                    "logicalValidity": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the logical validity of the reasoning step.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "inferenceStrength": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the strength of the inference.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "step",
                    "potentialBiases",
                    "assumptions",
                    "logicalValidity",
                    "inferenceStrength"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of reasoning steps being assessed."
              },
              "overallConfidence": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "An overall confidence score (0-1) in the ability to complete the task successfully.",
                "minimum": 0,
                "maximum": 1
              },
              "uncertaintyAreas": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of areas where there is significant uncertainty."
              },
              "recommendedApproach": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The recommended approach to address the task, given the metacognitive assessment."
              },
              "monitoringId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this monitoring session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this monitoring session."
              },
              "suggestedAssessments": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "knowledge",
                    "claim",
                    "reasoning",
                    "overall"
                  ]
                },
                "description": "A list of suggested next assessments."
              },
              "previousSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A record of the steps that have already been completed."
              },
              "remainingSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A high-level list of the steps that are yet to be taken."
              },
              "toolUsageHistory": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "toolName": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the tool that was used."
                    },
                    "usedAt": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The timestamp at which the tool was used."
                    },
                    "effectivenessScore": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score indicating the effectiveness of the tool."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "toolName",
                    "usedAt"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A log of the tools that have been used so far, along with their effectiveness."
              },
              "nextAssessmentNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another assessment is required."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "task",
              "stage",
              "overallConfidence",
              "uncertaintyAreas",
              "recommendedApproach",
              "monitoringId",
              "iteration",
              "nextAssessmentNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__problem_decomposition",
          "description": "Breaking down complex problems into manageable sub-problems and tasks.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and comprehensive description of the problem to be decomposed."
              },
              "decompositionId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this decomposition."
              },
              "methodology": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The methodology or approach used for decomposition (e.g., 'Work Breakdown Structure', 'Feature-driven')."
              },
              "scope": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The scope and boundaries of this problem decomposition."
              },
              "objectives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "The main objectives to be achieved through this decomposition."
              },
              "decomposition": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the task."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the task and its objectives."
                    },
                    "subTasks": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A hierarchical list of sub-tasks that make up this task."
                    },
                    "dependencies": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of task IDs that this task depends on."
                    },
                    "effortEstimate": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "An estimate of the effort required (e.g., '2 days', '40 hours')."
                    },
                    "implementationOrder": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The order in which this task should be implemented."
                    },
                    "priority": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high",
                        "critical"
                      ],
                      "description": "Priority level of this task."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high"
                      ],
                      "description": "Complexity level of this task."
                    },
                    "category": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Category or type of work this task represents."
                    },
                    "tags": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Tags for categorizing and filtering tasks."
                    },
                    "resourceRequirements": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "type": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [

                            "type": "string",

                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high",
                              "critical"
                            ],
                            "description": "How critical this resource is for task completion."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "type",
                          "description",
                          "availability",
                          "criticality"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Resources required to complete this task."
                    },
                    "risks": {

                            "minimum": 0,

                        "required": [

                    "stakeholders": {
                      "type": "array",

                        "type": "object",

                          "name": {
                            "type": "string",

                              "owner",

                              "reviewer",

                            "description": "The stakeholder's role in this task."

                          "influence": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of influence this stakeholder has."

                          "interest": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of interest this stakeholder has."
                          },
                          "availability": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Availability of this stakeholder."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "name",
                          "role",
                          "influence",
                          "interest"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Stakeholders involved in or affected by this task."
                    },
                    "acceptanceCriteria": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "A unique identifier for the acceptance criterion."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of what must be achieved for the task to be considered complete."
                          },
                          "measurable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "description": "Whether this criterion can be objectively measured."
                          },
                          "priority": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "must-have",
                              "should-have",
                              "could-have",

                            "description": "Priority level of this criterion."

                          "testable": {

                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "description",
                          "measurable",
                          "priority",
                          "testable"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Criteria that must be met for the task to be considered complete."
                    },
                    "progress": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "status": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "not-started",
                            "in-progress",
                            "blocked",
                            "completed",
                            "cancelled"
                          ],
                          "description": "Current status of the task."
                        },
                        "percentComplete": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 100,
                          "description": "Percentage completion (0-100)."
                        },
                        "startDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned start date."
                        },
                        "endDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned end date."
                        },
                        "lastUpdated": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "When the progress was last updated."
                        },
                        "blockers": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "Current blockers preventing progress."
                        },
                        "milestones": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "properties": {
                              "name": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Name of the milestone."
                              },
                              "date": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Target or actual date of the milestone."
                              },
                              "achieved": {
                                "type": "boolean",
                                "description": "Whether the milestone has been achieved."
                              }
                            },
                            "required": [
                              "name",
                              "date",
                              "achieved"
                            ],
                            "additionalProperties": false
                          },
                          "description": "Key milestones for this task."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "status"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Current progress and status of the task."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Assumptions made about this task."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Constraints that limit how this task can be completed."
                    },
                    "deliverables": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Specific deliverables expected from this task."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "id",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A hierarchical list of tasks that the problem is decomposed into."
              },
              "metrics": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "totalTasks": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "Total number of tasks in the decomposition."
                  },
                  "maxDepth": {
                    "type": "number",

                    },

                  },
                  "riskScore": {

                    "maximum": 1,

                  },
                  "complexityDistribution": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                      "low": {
                        "type": "number",

                      },
                      "medium": {
                        "type": "number",
                        "description": "Number of medium complexity tasks."
                      },
                      "high": {
                        "type": "number",
                        "description": "Number of high complexity tasks."
                      }
                    },
                    "required": [
                      "low",
                      "medium",
                      "high"
                    ],
                    "additionalProperties": false,
                    "description": "Distribution of tasks by complexity level."
                  }
                },
                "required": [

                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Metrics and analysis of the decomposition."
              },

                "type": "array",

                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Checklist items to verify completeness of the decomposition."
              },
              "reviewNotes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Notes from reviews of this decomposition."
              },
              "alternativeApproaches": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Alternative ways the problem could have been decomposed."
              },
