                      "description": "Category or type of work this task represents."
                    },
                    "tags": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Tags for categorizing and filtering tasks."
                    },
                    "resourceRequirements": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "type": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "human",
                              "financial",
                              "technical",
                              "infrastructure",
                              "external"
                            ],
                            "description": "The type of resource required."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of the specific resource needed."
                          },
                          "quantity": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Quantity or amount of the resource needed."
                          },
                          "availability": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "available",
                              "limited",
                              "unavailable",
                              "unknown"
                            ],
                            "description": "Current availability of this resource."
                          },
                          "criticality": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high",
                              "critical"
                            ],
                            "description": "How critical this resource is for task completion."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "type",
                          "description",
                          "availability",
                          "criticality"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Resources required to complete this task."
                    },
                    "risks": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "A unique identifier for the risk."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of the potential risk."
                          },
                          "probability": {
                            "type": "number",
                            "description": "Probability (0-1) of the risk occurring.",
                            "minimum": 0,
                            "maximum": 1
                          },
                          "impact": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high",
                              "critical"
                            ],
                            "description": "Impact level if the risk materializes."
                          },
                          "category": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "technical",
                              "resource",
                              "timeline",
                              "external",
                              "quality"
                            ],
                            "description": "Category of the risk."
                          },
                          "mitigation": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Strategies to mitigate this risk."
                          },
                          "contingency": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Contingency plan if the risk occurs."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "description",
                          "probability",
                          "impact",
                          "category"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Potential risks associated with this task."
                    },
                    "stakeholders": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "name": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Name or role of the stakeholder."
                          },
                          "role": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "owner",
                              "contributor",
                              "reviewer",
                              "approver",
                              "informed"
                            ],
                            "description": "The stakeholder's role in this task."
                          },
                          "influence": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of influence this stakeholder has."
                          },
                          "interest": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of interest this stakeholder has."
                          },
                          "availability": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Availability of this stakeholder."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "name",
                          "role",
                          "influence",
                          "interest"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Stakeholders involved in or affected by this task."
                    },
                    "acceptanceCriteria": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "A unique identifier for the acceptance criterion."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of what must be achieved for the task to be considered complete."
                          },
                          "measurable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "description": "Whether this criterion can be objectively measured."
                          },
                          "priority": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "must-have",
                              "should-have",
                              "could-have",
                              "won't-have"
                            ],
                            "description": "Priority level of this criterion."
                          },
                          "testable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "description": "Whether this criterion can be tested or verified."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "description",
                          "measurable",
                          "priority",
                          "testable"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Criteria that must be met for the task to be considered complete."
                    },
                    "progress": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "status": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "not-started",
                            "in-progress",
                            "blocked",
                            "completed",
                            "cancelled"
                          ],
                          "description": "Current status of the task."
                        },
                        "percentComplete": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 100,
                          "description": "Percentage completion (0-100)."
                        },
                        "startDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned start date."
                        },
                        "endDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned end date."
                        },
                        "lastUpdated": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "When the progress was last updated."
                        },
                        "blockers": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "Current blockers preventing progress."
                        },
                        "milestones": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "properties": {
                              "name": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Name of the milestone."
                              },
                              "date": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Target or actual date of the milestone."
                              },
                              "achieved": {
                                "type": "boolean",
                                "description": "Whether the milestone has been achieved."
                              }
                            },
                            "required": [
                              "name",
                              "date",
                              "achieved"
                            ],
                            "additionalProperties": false
                          },
                          "description": "Key milestones for this task."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "status"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Current progress and status of the task."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Assumptions made about this task."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Constraints that limit how this task can be completed."
                    },
                    "deliverables": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Specific deliverables expected from this task."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "id",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A hierarchical list of tasks that the problem is decomposed into."
              },
              "metrics": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "totalTasks": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "Total number of tasks in the decomposition."
                  },
                  "maxDepth": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "Maximum depth of the task hierarchy."
                  },
                  "estimatedTotalEffort": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Total estimated effort across all tasks."
                  },
                  "criticalPath": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Task IDs that form the critical path."
                  },
                  "riskScore": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1,
                    "description": "Overall risk score (0-1) for the entire decomposition."
                  },
                  "complexityDistribution": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                      "low": {
                        "type": "number",
                        "description": "Number of low complexity tasks."
                      },
                      "medium": {
                        "type": "number",
                        "description": "Number of medium complexity tasks."
                      },
                      "high": {
                        "type": "number",
                        "description": "Number of high complexity tasks."
                      }
                    },
                    "required": [
                      "low",
                      "medium",
                      "high"
                    ],
                    "additionalProperties": false,
                    "description": "Distribution of tasks by complexity level."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "totalTasks",
                  "maxDepth"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Metrics and analysis of the decomposition."
              },
              "completenessCheck": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Checklist items to verify completeness of the decomposition."
              },
              "reviewNotes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Notes from reviews of this decomposition."
              },
              "alternativeApproaches": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Alternative ways the problem could have been decomposed."
              },
              "createdBy": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Who created this decomposition."
              },
              "createdDate": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "When this decomposition was created."
              },
              "lastModified": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "When this decomposition was last modified."
              },
              "version": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Version of this decomposition."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "problem",
              "decomposition"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__recursive_thinking",
          "description": "Applying recursive strategies to solve problems with base and recursive cases, including optimizations.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and comprehensive description of the problem to be solved recursively."
              },
              "problemId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this recursive problem analysis."
              },
              "domain": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The domain or field this problem belongs to (e.g., 'algorithms', 'data structures')."
              },
              "baseCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the base case."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that defines when this base case applies."
                    },
                    "solution": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The direct solution for this base case."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Time/space complexity of solving this base case."
                    },
                    "examples": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Concrete examples of inputs that trigger this base case."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "condition",
                    "solution"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The base cases that terminate the recursion."
              },
              "recursiveCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the recursive case."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that defines when this recursive case applies."
                    },
                    "decomposition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the problem is broken down into smaller subproblems."
                    },
                    "recombination": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the solutions to subproblems are combined."
                    },
                    "reductionFactor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How much the problem size is reduced in each recursive call."
                    },
                    "examples": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Concrete examples of inputs that trigger this recursive case."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "condition",
                    "decomposition",
                    "recombination"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The recursive cases that break down the problem."
              },
              "terminationConditions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "All conditions under which the recursion will terminate."
              },
              "complexityAnalysis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "timeComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The time complexity of the recursive solution (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(2^n)')."
                  },
                  "spaceComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                  },
                  "maxStackDepth": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                  },
                  "worstCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                  },
                  "bestCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "timeComplexity",
                  "spaceComplexity"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Detailed complexity analysis of the recursive solution."
              },
              "optimizations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "technique": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The optimization technique (e.g., 'memoization', 'tail recursion')."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Description of how the optimization works."
                    },
                    "complexityImprovement": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the optimization improves complexity."
                    },
                    "tradeoffs": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Trade-offs introduced by this optimization."
                    },
                    "implementation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Implementation details or pseudocode for the optimization."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "technique",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Possible optimizations for the recursive solution."
              },
              "iterativeAlternatives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "approach": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The iterative approach (e.g., 'bottom-up dynamic programming', 'stack-based iteration')."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Detailed description of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "advantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Advantages of the iterative approach over recursion."
                    },
                    "disadvantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Disadvantages of the iterative approach."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "timeComplexity": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The time complexity of the recursive solution (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(2^n)')."
                        },
                        "spaceComplexity": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                        },
                        "maxStackDepth": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                        },
                        "worstCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                        },
                        "bestCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "timeComplexity",
                        "spaceComplexity"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Complexity analysis of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "implementation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Pseudocode or implementation details."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "approach",
                    "description",
                    "advantages",
                    "disadvantages"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Alternative iterative solutions."
              },
              "stackOverflowRisk": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "low",
                  "medium",
                  "high"
                ],
                "description": "Risk of stack overflow for typical inputs."
              },
              "inputSizeLimit": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Practical limit on input size before stack overflow."
              },
              "tailRecursionOptimizable": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Whether the recursion can be optimized with tail recursion."
              },
              "invariants": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Properties that remain true throughout the recursive calls."
              },
              "testCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "input": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Description of the test input."
                    },
                    "expectedOutput": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Expected output for this input."
                    },
                    "reasoning": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Why this test case is important."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "input",
                    "expectedOutput"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Key test cases for validating the recursive solution."
              },
              "recursionPattern": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "linear",
                  "binary",
                  "tree",
                  "mutual",
                  "indirect",
                  "nested"
                ],
                "description": "The pattern of recursion used."
              },
              "similarProblems": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Other problems that use similar recursive patterns."
              },
              "learningObjectives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "What can be learned from this recursive analysis."
              },
              "commonMistakes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Common mistakes when implementing this recursive solution."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "problem",
              "baseCases",
              "recursiveCases",
              "terminationConditions"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__scientific_method",
          "description": "Formal hypothesis testing and experimentation following the scientific method.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "observation",
                  "question",
                  "hypothesis",
                  "experiment",
                  "analysis",
                  "conclusion",
                  "iteration"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage in the scientific inquiry process."
              },
              "observation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "An initial observation that sparks inquiry (e.g., 'The new feature has lower engagement than expected')."
              },
              "question": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A specific question that arises from the observation (e.g., 'Why is user engagement low?')."
              },
              "hypothesis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "statement": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A clear, falsifiable statement predicting a relationship between variables (e.g., 'Reducing button size will decrease user conversion rate')."
                  },
                  "variables": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "name": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The name of the variable (e.g., 'user conversion rate', 'website latency')."
                        },
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "independent",
                            "dependent",
                            "controlled",
                            "confounding"
                          ],
                          "description": "The role of the variable in the experiment. Independent: the one you change. Dependent: the one you measure. Controlled: the ones you keep constant."
                        },
                        "operationalization": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "A precise description of how the variable will be measured or manipulated (e.g., 'Latency measured as Time to First Byte in ms', 'Conversion measured by sign-ups per 1000 visitors')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "name",
                        "type"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "An array defining all variables involved in the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "assumptions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Any conditions assumed to be true for the hypothesis to hold (e.g., 'Users notice button size')."
                  },
                  "hypothesisId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for tracking this specific hypothesis."
                  },
                  "confidence": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A prior confidence score (0-1) in the hypothesis before testing.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "domain": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific area of study or context of the hypothesis (e.g., 'UI/UX Optimization')."
                  },
                  "iteration": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "The version number of this hypothesis, for tracking refinements."
                  },
                  "alternativeTo": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of IDs of competing or alternative hypotheses."
                  },
                  "refinementOf": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of a previous, broader hypothesis that this one refines."
                  },
                  "status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "proposed",
                      "testing",
                      "supported",
                      "refuted",
                      "refined"
                    ],
                    "description": "The current lifecycle stage of the hypothesis."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "statement",
                  "variables",
                  "assumptions",
                  "hypothesisId",
                  "confidence",
                  "domain",
                  "iteration",
                  "status"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The formal hypothesis being investigated."
              },
              "experiment": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "design": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A description of the experimental design (e.g., 'A/B Test', 'Repeated Measures Design')."
                  },
                  "methodology": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The step-by-step procedure for conducting the experiment."
                  },
                  "predictions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "if": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific condition or action to be taken in the experiment (e.g., 'If we decrease the button size by 50%')."
                        },
                        "then": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific, measurable outcome expected if the hypothesis is true (e.g., 'then the user conversion rate will drop by at least 5%')."
                        },
                        "else": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "An alternative outcome, which might support a competing hypothesis (e.g., 'else the conversion rate will remain unchanged')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "if",
                        "then"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "The specific, testable predictions derived from the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "experimentId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for this specific experiment."
                  },
                  "hypothesisId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of the hypothesis this experiment is designed to test."
                  },
                  "controlMeasures": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Measures taken to prevent confounding variables from influencing the results (e.g., 'Ensuring both user groups have similar demographics')."
                  },
                  "results": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A summary of the raw data or findings from the experiment."
                  },
                  "outcomeMatched": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "description": "A flag indicating whether the results matched the 'then' part of the prediction."
                  },
                  "unexpectedObservations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Any surprising findings not anticipated by the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "limitations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Factors that may limit the generalizability of the findings (e.g., 'Sample size was small')."
                  },
                  "nextSteps": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Proposed follow-up actions, such as further experiments or analysis."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "design",
                  "methodology",
                  "predictions",
                  "experimentId",
                  "hypothesisId",
                  "controlMeasures"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The design and details of the experiment to test the hypothesis."
              },
              "analysis": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The interpretation of the experimental results and statistical analysis."
              },
              "conclusion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final conclusion drawn from the analysis, stating whether the hypothesis was supported or refuted."
              },
              "inquiryId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for the entire scientific inquiry from observation to conclusion."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of the inquiry process, for tracking cycles of refinement."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether the inquiry requires a subsequent stage."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "stage",
              "inquiryId",
              "iteration",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__sequential_thinking",
          "description": "A detailed tool for dynamic and reflective problem-solving through thoughts. This tool helps analyze problems through a flexible thinking process that can adapt and evolve.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "thought": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The core thinking process or analysis at this stage, forming a coherent narrative.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "thoughtNumber": {
                "type": "integer",
                "description": "The sequential number of the current thought in the series.",
                "minimum": 0
              },
              "totalThoughts": {
                "type": "integer",
                "description": "The total number of thoughts planned for this problem-solving session.",
                "minimum": 0
              },
              "nextThoughtNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another thought is required to continue the process."
              },
              "isRevision": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Indicates if this thought is a revision of a previous one."
              },
              "revisesThought": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "The number of the thought that this one revises, if applicable."
              },
              "branchFromThought": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "The thought number from which a new branch of thinking emerges."
              },
              "branchId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for a specific branch of thought, allowing for parallel exploration."
              },
              "needsMoreThoughts": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Indicates if the current plan needs more thoughts to be added."
              },
              "currentStep": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "stepDescription": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A clear and concise description of the step to be taken."
                  },
                  "recommendedTools": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "toolName": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The name of the recommended tool."
                        },
                        "confidence": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the recommendation.",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 1
                        },
                        "rationale": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The rationale for recommending this tool."
                        },
                        "priority": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "The priority of this tool recommendation."
                        },
                        "alternativeTools": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "A list of alternative tools that could be used."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "toolName",
                        "confidence",
                        "rationale",
                        "priority"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "A list of recommended tools to be used for this step, with confidence scores."
                  },
                  "expectedOutcome": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The expected outcome after completing this step."
                  },
                  "nextStepConditions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Conditions that would trigger the next step or a branch in the thought process."
                  },
                  "stepNumber": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "The sequential number of the current step."
                  },
                  "estimatedDuration": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "An estimation of how long this step might take."
                  },
                  "complexityLevel": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "low",
                      "medium",
                      "high"
                    ],
                    "description": "The assessed complexity level of this step."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "stepDescription",
                  "recommendedTools",
                  "expectedOutcome",
                  "nextStepConditions"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The detailed description of the immediate next step to be executed."
              },
              "previousSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "stepDescription": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A clear and concise description of the step to be taken."
                    },
                    "recommendedTools": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "toolName": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "The name of the recommended tool."
                          },
                          "confidence": {
                            "type": "number",
                            "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the recommendation.",
                            "minimum": 0,
                            "maximum": 1
                          },
                          "rationale": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "The rationale for recommending this tool."
                          },
                          "priority": {
                            "type": "number",
                            "description": "The priority of this tool recommendation."
                          },
                          "alternativeTools": {
                            "type": "array",
                            "items": {
                              "type": "string"
                            },
                            "description": "A list of alternative tools that could be used."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "toolName",
                          "confidence",
                          "rationale",
                          "priority"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "A list of recommended tools to be used for this step, with confidence scores."
                    },
                    "expectedOutcome": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The expected outcome after completing this step."
                    },
                    "nextStepConditions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Conditions that would trigger the next step or a branch in the thought process."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "stepDescription",
                    "recommendedTools",
                    "expectedOutcome",
                    "nextStepConditions"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A record of the steps that have already been completed."
              },
              "remainingSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A high-level list of the steps that are yet to be taken."
              },
              "toolUsageHistory": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "toolName": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the tool that was used."
                    },
                    "usedAt": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The timestamp at which the tool was used."
                    },
                    "effectivenessScore": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score indicating the effectiveness of the tool."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "toolName",
                    "usedAt"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A log of the tools that have been used so far, along with their effectiveness."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "thought",
              "thoughtNumber",
              "totalThoughts",
              "nextThoughtNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__stochastic_algorithm",
          "description": "Probabilistic algorithms for decision-making under uncertainty, including MDPs, MCTS, and Bayesian optimization.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "algorithm": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the stochastic algorithm to be used (e.g., 'Monte Carlo Tree Search', 'Simulated Annealing').",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A formal description of the problem to be solved, including the state space, actions, and objective function if applicable.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "parameters": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Algorithm-specific parameters. For MCTS, this could be {'simulations': 1000, 'exploration_constant': 1.41}. For Simulated Annealing, {'initial_temp': 1000, 'cooling_rate': 0.995}."
              },
              "result": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The output of the algorithm, which could be an optimal policy, a selected action, a predicted value, or a solution path."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "algorithm",
              "problem"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__structured_argumentation",
          "description": "Dialectical reasoning and argument analysis for structured debates and logical reasoning.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "claim": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The central claim or assertion being made."
              },
              "premises": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of reasons or evidence supporting the claim."
              },
              "conclusion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The logical conclusion drawn from the premises."
              },
              "argumentId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this argument."
              },
              "argumentType": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "thesis",
                  "antithesis",
                  "synthesis",
                  "objection",
                  "rebuttal"
                ],
                "description": "The type of argument being made."
              },
              "confidence": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the validity of the argument.",
                "minimum": 0,
                "maximum": 1
              },
              "respondsTo": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The ID of the argument to which this one is responding."
              },
              "supports": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of argument IDs that this argument supports."
              },
              "contradicts": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of argument IDs that this argument contradicts."
              },
              "strengths": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of the argument's strengths."
              },
              "weaknesses": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of the argument's weaknesses."
              },
              "nextArgumentNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another argument is needed to continue the debate."
              },
              "suggestedNextTypes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "thesis",
                    "antithesis",
                    "synthesis",
                    "objection",
                    "rebuttal"
                  ]
                },
                "description": "A list of suggested types for the next argument."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "claim",
              "premises",
              "conclusion",
              "argumentType",
              "confidence",
              "nextArgumentNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__temporal_thinking",
          "description": "Modeling systems and reasoning across time using states, events, and transitions.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "context": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A comprehensive description of the system or process being modeled."
              },
              "modelId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this temporal model."
              },
              "domain": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The domain this model belongs to (e.g., 'business process', 'software system')."
              },
              "purpose": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The purpose or goal of creating this temporal model."
              },
              "initialState": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the initial state of the system."
              },
              "states": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The unique name of the state."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of what this state represents."
                    },
                    "properties": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "isInitial": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Whether this is an initial state."
                        },
                        "isFinal": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Whether this is a final/terminal state."
                        },
                        "isStable": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Whether this state is stable or transient."
                        },
                        "duration": {
                          "type": "object",
                          "properties": {
                            "min": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "description": "Minimum time spent in this state."
                            },
                            "max": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "description": "Maximum time spent in this state."
                            },
                            "typical": {
                              "type": "string",
                              "description": "Typical time spent in this state."
                            }
                          },
                          "required": [],
                          "additionalProperties": false,
                          "description": "Duration constraints for this state."
                        },
                        "capacity": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Maximum number of entities that can be in this state simultaneously."
                        },
                        "cost": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Cost associated with being in this state."
                        },
                        "priority": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "low",
                            "medium",
                            "high",
                            "critical"
                          ],
                          "description": "Priority level of this state."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Additional properties and constraints for this state."
                    },
                    "invariants": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Conditions that must always be true while in this state."
                    },
                    "entryActions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Actions performed when entering this state."
                    },
                    "exitActions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Actions performed when leaving this state."
                    },
                    "subStates": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Sub-states if this is a composite state."
                    },
                    "parentState": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Parent state if this is a sub-state."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A comprehensive list of all possible states in the system."
              },
              "events": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The unique name of the event that triggers a transition."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of what causes this event."
                    },
                    "properties": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "internal",
                            "external",
                            "timer",
                            "condition"
                          ],
                          "description": "The type of event."
                        },
                        "frequency": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "How often this event typically occurs."
                        },
                        "predictability": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "deterministic",
                            "stochastic",
                            "unpredictable"
                          ],
                          "description": "Predictability of the event."
                        },
                        "priority": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "low",
                            "medium",
                            "high",
                            "critical"
                          ],
                          "description": "Priority level of this event."
                        },
                        "cost": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Cost associated with this event occurring."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Additional properties of the event."
                    },
                    "preconditions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Conditions that must be met for this event to occur."
                    },
                    "parameters": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "name": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Name of the parameter."
                          },
                          "type": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Type of the parameter."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of the parameter."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "name",
                          "type"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Parameters associated with this event."
                    },
                    "triggers": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "What can trigger this event."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A comprehensive list of all possible events that can occur."
              },
              "transitions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "from": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the state from which the transition originates."
                    },
                    "to": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the state to which the transition leads."
                    },
                    "event": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the event that triggers this transition."
                    },
                    "guard": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A condition that must be true for the transition to occur."
                    },
                    "action": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "An action that is performed when this transition occurs."
                    },
                    "properties": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "probability": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 1,
                          "description": "Probability of this transition occurring when the event happens."
                        },
                        "duration": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Time taken for this transition to complete."
                        },
                        "cost": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Cost associated with this transition."
                        },
                        "priority": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "low",
                            "medium",
                            "high",
                            "critical"
                          ],
                          "description": "Priority of this transition."
                        },
                        "reversible": {
                          "type": "boolean",
                          "description": "Whether this transition can be reversed."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Additional properties of the transition."
                    },
                    "sideEffects": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Side effects that occur during this transition."
                    },
                    "rollbackActions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Actions to perform if the transition needs to be rolled back."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "from",
                    "to",
                    "event"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A comprehensive list of all possible transitions between states."
              },
              "finalStates": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of states that are considered terminal or final."
              },
              "sequenceDiagram": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "title": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Title of the sequence diagram."
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of what the sequence diagram shows."
                  },
                  "actors": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "name": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Name of the actor/participant in the sequence."
                        },
                        "description": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of the actor's role."
                        },
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "user",
                            "system",
                            "service",
                            "database",
                            "external"
                          ],
                          "description": "Type of actor."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "name"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "Actors/participants in the sequence."
                  },
                  "steps": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "id": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Unique identifier for this sequence step."
                        },
                        "from": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actor sending the message/action."
                        },
                        "to": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actor receiving the message/action."
                        },
                        "message": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The message or action being performed."
                        },
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "sync",
                            "async",
                            "return",
                            "create",
                            "destroy",
                            "note"
                          ],
                          "description": "Type of sequence interaction."
                        },
                        "timestamp": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "When this interaction occurs."
                        },
                        "condition": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Condition under which this interaction happens."
                        },
                        "duration": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "How long this interaction takes."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "id",
                        "from",
                        "to",
                        "message"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "Sequential steps in the interaction."
                  },
                  "notes": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Additional notes about the sequence."
                  },
                  "mermaidSyntax": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Generated Mermaid sequence diagram syntax."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "title",
                  "actors",
                  "steps"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Generated sequence diagram showing temporal interactions between actors."
              },
              "generateSequenceDiagram": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Whether to automatically generate a sequence diagram from the temporal model."
              },
              "analysis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "reachability": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                      "reachableStates": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "description": "States that can be reached from the initial state."
                      },
                      "unreachableStates": {
