                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "description": "States that cannot be reached."
                      },
                      "deadlockStates": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "description": "States from which no further transitions are possible."
                      }
                    },
                    "required": [
                      "reachableStates"
                    ],
                    "additionalProperties": false,
                    "description": "Reachability analysis of the state machine."
                  },
                  "cycles": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "states": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "States involved in the cycle."
                        },
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "simple",
                            "complex",
                            "self-loop"
                          ],
                          "description": "Type of cycle."
                        },
                        "length": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "Number of transitions in the cycle."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "states",
                        "type",
                        "length"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "Cycles detected in the state machine."
                  },
                  "criticalPaths": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "path": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "Sequence of states in the critical path."
                        },
                        "duration": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Total duration of this path."
                        },
                        "probability": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 1,
                          "description": "Probability of following this path."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "path"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "Critical paths through the state machine."
                  },
                  "bottlenecks": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "state": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "State that acts as a bottleneck."
                        },
                        "reason": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Why this state is a bottleneck."
                        },
                        "impact": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "low",
                            "medium",
                            "high"
                          ],
                          "description": "Impact level of the bottleneck."
                        }
                      },

          "parameters": {

        {
          "name": "plugin_manager",
          "description": "List plugins or bundles in the current profile, enable or disable them, install a bundle, or remove an installed bundle. Every action requires danger-full-access permission or approval for this call. Approval does not change the session permission mode. Changes affect every session in this profile. List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "action": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Management operation.",
                "enum": [
                  "list_plugins",
                  "list_bundles",
                  "set_plugin",
                  "set_bundle",
                  "install_bundle",
                  "remove_bundle",
                  "list_version_exemptions",
                  "set_version_exemption"
                ]
              },
              "target": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Plugin entry id, bundle package name, or installation spec, according to action. For an Official catalog entry, pass list_bundles installTarget.spec to install_bundle."

              },
              "runtimeVersion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "For set_version_exemption: exact DSH version from list_version_exemptions. Target must be the manifest package-name@version, not an alias or version range."
              },
              "acceptRisk": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "For granting an exemption: true only after warning the user about possible crashes and data loss and receiving explicit permission for this exact plugin/runtime pair. General installation permission is not enough."
              },
              "approvedBuilds": {
                "type": "array",
                "description": "For install_bundle: pass names from pendingBuilds only after the user explicitly approves running their install scripts in the conversation. This grants persistent permission for this profile.",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"

              },
              "registry": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "For install_bundle: the npm registry URL asked first, when the user names one; otherwise the configured registry is asked, and its configured fallbacks while a registry is unreachable."

              "offset": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "Zero-based list offset; defaults to 0."

              "limit": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "List page size, from 1 to 100; defaults to 25."

            },
            "required": [
              "action"
            ]
          }

        {
          "name": "pwsh",
          "description": "Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with \"only core types\" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.",

              "prompt": {

                "description": "Instruction delivered at each occurrence."
              },
              "rrule": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: \"DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1\""

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__collaborative_reasoning",
          "description": "Multi-perspective collaborative problem solving with diverse personas and structured contributions.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "topic": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The central topic or problem being addressed in the collaborative session."
              },
              "personas": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the persona."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the persona (e.g., 'Devil's Advocate', 'Chief Technology Officer')."
                    },
                    "expertise": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of the persona's areas of expertise (e.g., 'cybersecurity', 'user experience')."
                    },
                    "background": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The background and context of the persona, informing their perspective."
                    },
                    "perspective": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The unique viewpoint or lens this persona brings to the discussion."
                    },
                    "biases": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of potential cognitive biases this persona may have (e.g., 'Confirmation Bias', 'Optimism Bias')."
                    },
                    "communication": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "style": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The communication style of the persona (e.g., 'Socratic', 'data-driven', 'narrative-focused')."
                        },
                        "tone": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The communication tone of the persona (e.g., 'skeptical', 'supportive', 'formal')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "style",
                        "tone"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "The communication style and tone of the persona."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "id",
                    "name",
                    "expertise",
                    "background",
                    "perspective",
                    "biases",
                    "communication"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The set of diverse personas participating in the reasoning process."
              },
              "contributions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "personaId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the persona making the contribution."
                    },
                    "content": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The substance of the contribution, such as an idea, question, or piece of evidence."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "observation",
                        "question",
                        "insight",
                        "concern",
                        "suggestion",
                        "challenge",
                        "synthesis"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of contribution, which frames its intent."
                    },
                    "confidence": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the validity or importance of the contribution.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "referenceIds": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of IDs of other contributions this one builds upon, challenges, or refers to."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "personaId",
                    "content",
                    "type",
                    "confidence"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A log of all contributions made during the session."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "problem-definition",
                  "ideation",
                  "critique",
                  "integration",
                  "decision",
                  "reflection"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the collaborative reasoning process, guiding the nature of contributions."
              },
              "activePersonaId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The ID of the persona who is currently expected to contribute."
              },
              "nextPersonaId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The ID of the persona designated to contribute next, guiding the conversation flow."
              },
              "consensusPoints": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of key points or decisions on which all personas have reached agreement."
              },
              "disagreements": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "topic": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific topic or point of contention."
                    },
                    "positions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "personaId": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "The ID of the persona advocating for this position."
                          },
                          "position": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "A clear statement of the position taken in the disagreement."
                          },
                          "arguments": {
                            "type": "array",
                            "items": {
                              "type": "string"
                            },
                            "description": "The key arguments and evidence supporting this position."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "personaId",
                          "position",
                          "arguments"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "The different positions taken by personas in the disagreement."
                    },
                    "resolution": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "consensus",
                            "compromise",
                            "integration",
                            "tabled"
                          ],
                          "description": "The method by which the disagreement was resolved."
                        },
                        "description": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "A summary of the resolution and the reasoning behind it."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "type",
                        "description"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "The outcome of the attempt to resolve the disagreement."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "topic",
                    "positions"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of active or resolved disagreements that have occurred."
              },
              "keyInsights": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of significant insights that have emerged from the discussion."
              },
              "openQuestions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of unresolved questions that require further discussion or information."
              },
              "finalRecommendation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final, synthesized recommendation or decision resulting from the session."
              },
              "sessionId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this collaborative reasoning session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The turn number or iteration of the session, for tracking progress."
              },
              "suggestedContributionTypes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "observation",
                    "question",
                    "insight",
                    "concern",
                    "suggestion",
                    "challenge",
                    "synthesis"
                  ]
                },
                "description": "A list of suggested types for the next contribution to guide the active persona."
              },
              "nextContributionNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether the session is awaiting another contribution to proceed."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "topic",
              "personas",
              "contributions",
              "stage",
              "activePersonaId",
              "sessionId",
              "iteration",
              "nextContributionNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__critical_thinking",
          "description": "Systematic evaluation of arguments, assumptions, and potential issues to improve reasoning quality.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "subject": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The code, design, requirement, or concept being critically analyzed."
              },
              "analysisId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this critical thinking session."
              },
              "context": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The broader context or background relevant to the analysis."
              },
              "objectives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "The specific objectives or goals of this critical analysis."
              },
              "methodology": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The approach or framework used for the critical analysis."
              },
              "potentialIssues": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the issue."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the potential issue or flaw."
                    },
                    "severity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high",
                        "critical"
                      ],
                      "description": "The severity level of the issue."
                    },
                    "category": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "logic",
                        "implementation",
                        "design",
                        "security",
                        "performance",
                        "usability",
                        "maintainability"
                      ],
                      "description": "The category of the issue."
                    },
                    "evidence": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Evidence supporting the existence of this issue."
                    },
                    "likelihood": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The probability (0-1) that this issue will actually occur.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "impact": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The potential impact if this issue manifests."
                    },
                    "mitigation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Suggested approaches to mitigate or resolve this issue."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "severity",
                    "category",
                    "likelihood"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A structured list of potential issues or flaws identified."
              },
              "edgeCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the edge case."
                    },
                    "scenario": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A description of the edge case scenario."
                    },
                    "conditions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "The specific conditions that trigger this edge case."
                    },
                    "expectedBehavior": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "What should happen in this edge case."
                    },
                    "currentBehavior": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "What currently happens (if known)."
                    },
                    "testability": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "easy",
                        "moderate",
                        "difficult",
                        "untestable"
                      ],
                      "description": "How easy it is to test this edge case."
                    },
                    "businessImpact": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "none",
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high"
                      ],
                      "description": "The business impact if this edge case is not handled."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "scenario",
                    "conditions",
                    "testability",
                    "businessImpact"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A structured list of edge cases that might not be handled correctly."
              },

        {

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__decision_framework",
          "description": "Structured decision analysis and rational choice frameworks for complex decisions.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "decisionStatement": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and concise statement of the decision to be made."
              },
              "options": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the decision option."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the decision option."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the decision option."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of the options being considered."
              },
              "criteria": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "weight": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The weight of the criterion in the decision (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "evaluationMethod": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "quantitative",
                        "qualitative",
                        "boolean"
                      ],
                      "description": "The method used to evaluate the criterion."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "weight",
                    "evaluationMethod"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of the criteria used to evaluate the options."
              },
              "stakeholders": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of stakeholders involved in the decision."
              },
              "constraints": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of constraints on the decision."
              },
              "timeHorizon": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The time horizon for the decision."
              },
              "riskTolerance": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "risk-averse",
                  "risk-neutral",
                  "risk-seeking"
                ],
                "description": "The risk tolerance for the decision."
              },
              "possibleOutcomes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the possible outcome."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the possible outcome."
                    },
                    "probability": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The probability of this outcome occurring (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "value": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The value of this outcome."
                    },
                    "optionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the option this outcome is associated with."
                    },
                    "confidenceInEstimate": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the probability and value estimates.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "probability",
                    "value",
                    "optionId",
                    "confidenceInEstimate"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of possible outcomes for the decision."
              },
              "criteriaEvaluations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "criterionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the criterion being evaluated."
                    },
                    "optionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the option being evaluated against the criterion."
                    },
                    "score": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The score of the option against the criterion (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "justification": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The justification for the score."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "criterionId",
                    "optionId",
                    "score",
                    "justification"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of evaluations of the options against the criteria."
              },
              "informationGaps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A description of the information gap."
                    },
                    "impact": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The potential impact of this information gap on the decision (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "researchMethod": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The method for researching and filling this information gap."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "impact",
                    "researchMethod"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of information gaps that need to be filled."
              },
              "analysisType": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "expected-utility",
                  "multi-criteria",
                  "maximin",
                  "minimax-regret",
                  "satisficing"
                ],
                "description": "The type of analysis to be performed."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "problem-definition",
                  "options",
                  "criteria",
                  "evaluation",
                  "analysis",
                  "recommendation"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the decision-making process."
              },
              "recommendation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final recommendation."
              },
              "sensitivityInsights": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of insights from sensitivity analysis."
              },
              "expectedValues": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "number"
                },
                "description": "A record of the expected values for each option."
              },
              "multiCriteriaScores": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "number"
                },
                "description": "A record of the multi-criteria scores for each option."
              },
              "decisionId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this decision."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this decision-making process."
              },
              "suggestedNextStage": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The suggested next stage in the decision-making process."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another stage is needed."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "decisionStatement",
              "options",
              "analysisType",
              "stage",
              "decisionId",
              "iteration",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__domain_modeling",
          "description": "Creating and refining conceptual models of a domain, including entities, relationships, and rules.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "domainName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the domain being modeled."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A detailed description of the domain."
              },
              "modelingId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this modeling session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this modeling session."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "analysis",
                  "conceptual",
                  "logical",
                  "physical",
                  "validation",
                  "refinement"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the modeling process."
              },
              "entities": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the entity."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the entity."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the entity's purpose and role."
                    },
                    "attributes": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of data attributes associated with the entity."
                    },
                    "behaviors": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of behaviors or operations the entity can perform."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of rules or constraints that apply to this entity."
                    },
                    "invariants": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of conditions that must always be true for this entity."
                    }

                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "attributes"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all entities in the domain."
              },
              "relationships": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the relationship."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the relationship."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "one-to-one",
                        "one-to-many",
                        "many-to-many",
                        "inheritance",
                        "composition",
                        "aggregation",
                        "dependency"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of relationship between entities."
                    },
                    "sourceEntity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the source entity in the relationship."
                    },
                    "targetEntity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the target entity in the relationship."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the relationship."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of rules or constraints that apply to this relationship."
                    },
                    "cardinality": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The cardinality of the relationship (e.g., '1..*')."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "type",
                    "sourceEntity",
                    "targetEntity",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all relationships between entities."
              },
              "domainRules": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the domain rule."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "business-rule",
                        "validation-rule",
                        "constraint",
                        "invariant",
                        "axiom"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "entities": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of entities to which this rule applies."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that must be met for the rule to apply."
                    },
                    "consequence": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The consequence of the rule being met."
                    },
                    "priority": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high",
                        "critical"
                      ],
                      "description": "The priority of the domain rule."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "type",
                    "entities",
                    "condition"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all domain rules."
              },
              "boundaries": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The name of the bounded context."
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A description of the bounded context."
                  },
                  "includedEntities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of entities included in this bounded context."
                  },
                  "excludedConcepts": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of concepts explicitly excluded from this bounded context."
                  },
                  "interfaces": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of interfaces this bounded context exposes."
                  },
                  "responsibilities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of responsibilities of this bounded context."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "name",
                  "description",
                  "includedEntities"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The bounded context of the domain."
              },
              "assumptions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of assumptions made during the modeling process."
              },
              "stakeholders": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of stakeholders involved in the modeling process."
              },
              "useCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of use cases for the domain."
              },
              "modelValidation": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "completeness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the completeness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "consistency": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the consistency of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "correctness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the correctness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "issues": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of identified issues with the model."
                  },
                  "suggestions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of suggestions for improving the model."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "completeness",
                  "consistency",
                  "correctness"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Validation results for the model."
              },
              "abstractionLevel": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "high",
                  "medium",
                  "low"
                ],
                "description": "The level of abstraction of the model."
              },
              "paradigm": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "object-oriented",
                  "relational",
                  "functional",
                  "event-driven",
                  "service-oriented",
                  "domain-driven"
                ],
                "description": "The modeling paradigm used."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another modeling stage is required."
              },
              "suggestedNextStage": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The suggested next stage in the modeling process."
              },
              "modelingNotes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of notes related to the modeling process."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "domainName",
              "description",
              "modelingId",
              "iteration",
              "stage",
              "entities",
              "abstractionLevel",
              "paradigm",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__mental_model",
          "description": "Tool for creating and analyzing mental models to understand complex problems and systems.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "modelName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the mental model being used (e.g., 'Second-Order Thinking', 'First Principles'). This helps categorize the analysis.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear, specific, and bounded description of the problem being analyzed. A good problem statement is crucial for effective model application. For example, 'How can we reduce user friction in our onboarding flow?' is better than 'Make the app better'.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "steps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A sequential, logical breakdown of how the mental model is applied. Each step should be a clear action or point of analysis, demonstrating the model's framework."
              },
              "reasoning": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The core logic behind the analysis. Explain *why* this model is appropriate for this problem and *how* the steps connect to the model's principles. This is crucial for evaluating the application's quality."
              },
              "conclusion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final, actionable insight or decision. It should be a direct synthesis of the preceding steps and reasoning."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "modelName",
              "problem"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__metacognitive_monitoring",
          "description": "Self-assessment of knowledge and reasoning quality for improved metacognition.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "task": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The overall task or problem being addressed."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "knowledge-assessment",
                  "planning",
                  "execution",
                  "monitoring",
                  "evaluation",
                  "reflection"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the metacognitive process."
              },
              "knowledgeAssessment": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "domain": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific domain or topic being assessed."
                  },
                  "knowledgeLevel": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "expert",
                      "proficient",
                      "familiar",
                      "basic",
                      "minimal",
                      "none"
                    ],
                    "description": "The self-assessed level of knowledge in this domain."
                  },
                  "confidenceScore": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed knowledge level.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "supportingEvidence": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Evidence to support the assessed knowledge level."
                  },
                  "knownLimitations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of known limitations or gaps in knowledge."
                  },
                  "relevantTrainingCutoff": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The date of the last relevant training or data cutoff."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "domain",
                  "knowledgeLevel",
                  "confidenceScore",
                  "supportingEvidence",
                  "knownLimitations"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "An assessment of the knowledge required for the task."
              },
              "claims": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "claim": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific claim being assessed."
                    },
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "fact",
                        "inference",
                        "speculation",
                        "uncertain"
                      ],
                      "description": "The assessed status of the claim."
                    },
                    "confidenceScore": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed status of the claim.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "evidenceBasis": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The evidence supporting the assessment of the claim."
                    },
                    "falsifiabilityCriteria": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Criteria that could be used to falsify the claim."
                    },
                    "alternativeInterpretations": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of alternative interpretations of the evidence."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "claim",
                    "status",
                    "confidenceScore",
                    "evidenceBasis"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of claims being made and assessed."
              },
              "reasoningSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "step": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific step in the reasoning process being assessed."
                    },
                    "potentialBiases": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of potential cognitive biases that may be influencing the reasoning."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of assumptions being made in this reasoning step."
                    },
                    "logicalValidity": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the logical validity of the reasoning step.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "inferenceStrength": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the strength of the inference.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "step",
                    "potentialBiases",
                    "assumptions",
                    "logicalValidity",
                    "inferenceStrength"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of reasoning steps being assessed."
              },
              "overallConfidence": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "An overall confidence score (0-1) in the ability to complete the task successfully.",
                "minimum": 0,
                "maximum": 1
              },
              "uncertaintyAreas": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of areas where there is significant uncertainty."
              },
              "recommendedApproach": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The recommended approach to address the task, given the metacognitive assessment."
              },
              "monitoringId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this monitoring session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this monitoring session."
              },
              "suggestedAssessments": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "knowledge",
                    "claim",
                    "reasoning",
                    "overall"
                  ]
                },
                "description": "A list of suggested next assessments."
              },
              "previousSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A record of the steps that have already been completed."
              },
              "remainingSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A high-level list of the steps that are yet to be taken."
              },
              "toolUsageHistory": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "toolName": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the tool that was used."
                    },
                    "usedAt": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The timestamp at which the tool was used."
                    },
                    "effectivenessScore": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score indicating the effectiveness of the tool."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "toolName",
                    "usedAt"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A log of the tools that have been used so far, along with their effectiveness."
              },
              "nextAssessmentNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another assessment is required."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "task",
              "stage",
              "overallConfidence",
              "uncertaintyAreas",
              "recommendedApproach",
              "monitoringId",
              "iteration",
              "nextAssessmentNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__problem_decomposition",
          "description": "Breaking down complex problems into manageable sub-problems and tasks.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",

              },

              },

              },

                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "The main objectives to be achieved through this decomposition."

                "type": "array",

                      },

                      "type": "string",

                      "type": "string",

                      "type": "array",

                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Tags for categorizing and filtering tasks."

                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "type": {
                            "type": "string",

                              "human",

                              "technical",
                              "infrastructure",
                              "external"

                            "description": "The type of resource required."
                          },

                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of the specific resource needed."
                          },

                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Quantity or amount of the resource needed."
                          },
                          "availability": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "available",
                              "limited",
                              "unavailable",
                              "unknown"
                            ],
                            "description": "Current availability of this resource."
                          },
                          "criticality": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high",
                              "critical"
                            ],
                            "description": "How critical this resource is for task completion."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "type",
                          "description",
                          "availability",
                          "criticality"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Resources required to complete this task."
                    },

                      "type": "array",

                            "enum": [
                              "low",

                            "type": "string",

                              "technical",
                              "resource",
                              "timeline",
                              "external",
                              "quality"

                            "description": "Category of the risk."
                          },
                          "mitigation": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Strategies to mitigate this risk."
                          },
                          "contingency": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Contingency plan if the risk occurs."

                        },
                        "required": [
                          "description",
                          "probability",
                          "impact",
                          "category"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Potential risks associated with this task."
                    },
                    "stakeholders": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "name": {
                            "type": "string",

                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "owner",
                              "contributor",
                              "reviewer",
                              "approver",

                            "description": "The stakeholder's role in this task."
