                          "influence": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of influence this stakeholder has."
                          },
                          "interest": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of interest this stakeholder has."
                          },
                          "availability": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Availability of this stakeholder."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "name",
                          "role",
                          "influence",
                          "interest"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Stakeholders involved in or affected by this task."
                    },
                    "acceptanceCriteria": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "A unique identifier for the acceptance criterion."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of what must be achieved for the task to be considered complete."
                          },
                          "measurable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "description": "Whether this criterion can be objectively measured."
                          },
                          "priority": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "must-have",
                              "should-have",
                              "could-have",
                              "won't-have"
                            ],
                            "description": "Priority level of this criterion."
                          },
                          "testable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "description": "Whether this criterion can be tested or verified."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "description",
                          "measurable",
                          "priority",
                          "testable"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Criteria that must be met for the task to be considered complete."
                    },
                    "progress": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "status": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "not-started",
                            "in-progress",
                            "blocked",
                            "completed",
                            "cancelled"
                          ],
                          "description": "Current status of the task."
                        },
                        "percentComplete": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 100,
                          "description": "Percentage completion (0-100)."
                        },
                        "startDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned start date."
                        },
                        "endDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned end date."
                        },
                        "lastUpdated": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "When the progress was last updated."
                        },
                        "blockers": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "Current blockers preventing progress."
                        },
                        "milestones": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "properties": {
                              "name": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Name of the milestone."
                              },
                              "date": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Target or actual date of the milestone."
                              },
                              "achieved": {
                                "type": "boolean",
                                "description": "Whether the milestone has been achieved."
                              }
                            },
                            "required": [
                              "name",
                              "date",
                              "achieved"
                            ],
                            "additionalProperties": false
                          },
                          "description": "Key milestones for this task."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "status"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Current progress and status of the task."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Assumptions made about this task."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Constraints that limit how this task can be completed."
                    },
                    "deliverables": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Specific deliverables expected from this task."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "id",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A hierarchical list of tasks that the problem is decomposed into."
              },
              "metrics": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "totalTasks": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "Total number of tasks in the decomposition."
                  },
                  "maxDepth": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "Maximum depth of the task hierarchy."
                  },
                  "estimatedTotalEffort": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Total estimated effort across all tasks."
                  },
                  "criticalPath": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Task IDs that form the critical path."
                  },
                  "riskScore": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1,
                    "description": "Overall risk score (0-1) for the entire decomposition."
                  },
                  "complexityDistribution": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                      "low": {
                        "type": "number",
                        "description": "Number of low complexity tasks."
                      },
                      "medium": {
                        "type": "number",
                        "description": "Number of medium complexity tasks."
                      },
                      "high": {
                        "type": "number",
                        "description": "Number of high complexity tasks."
                      }
                    },
                    "required": [
                      "low",
                      "medium",
                      "high"
                    ],
                    "additionalProperties": false,
                    "description": "Distribution of tasks by complexity level."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "totalTasks",
                  "maxDepth"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Metrics and analysis of the decomposition."
              },
              "completenessCheck": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Checklist items to verify completeness of the decomposition."
              },
              "reviewNotes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Notes from reviews of this decomposition."
              },
              "alternativeApproaches": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Alternative ways the problem could have been decomposed."
              },
              "createdBy": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Who created this decomposition."
              },
              "createdDate": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "When this decomposition was created."
              },
              "lastModified": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "When this decomposition was last modified."
              },
              "version": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Version of this decomposition."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "problem",
              "decomposition"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__recursive_thinking",
          "description": "Applying recursive strategies to solve problems with base and recursive cases, including optimizations.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and comprehensive description of the problem to be solved recursively."
              },
              "problemId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this recursive problem analysis."
              },
              "domain": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The domain or field this problem belongs to (e.g., 'algorithms', 'data structures')."
              },
              "baseCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the base case."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that defines when this base case applies."
                    },
                    "solution": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The direct solution for this base case."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Time/space complexity of solving this base case."
                    },
                    "examples": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Concrete examples of inputs that trigger this base case."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "condition",
                    "solution"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The base cases that terminate the recursion."
              },
              "recursiveCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the recursive case."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that defines when this recursive case applies."
                    },
                    "decomposition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the problem is broken down into smaller subproblems."
                    },
                    "recombination": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the solutions to subproblems are combined."
                    },
                    "reductionFactor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How much the problem size is reduced in each recursive call."
                    },
                    "examples": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Concrete examples of inputs that trigger this recursive case."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "condition",
                    "decomposition",
                    "recombination"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The recursive cases that break down the problem."
              },
              "terminationConditions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "All conditions under which the recursion will terminate."
              },
              "complexityAnalysis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "timeComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The time complexity of the recursive solution (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(2^n)')."
                  },
                  "spaceComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                  },
                  "maxStackDepth": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                  },
                  "worstCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                  },
                  "bestCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "timeComplexity",
                  "spaceComplexity"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Detailed complexity analysis of the recursive solution."
              },
              "optimizations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "technique": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The optimization technique (e.g., 'memoization', 'tail recursion')."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Description of how the optimization works."
                    },
                    "complexityImprovement": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the optimization improves complexity."
                    },
                    "tradeoffs": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Trade-offs introduced by this optimization."
                    },
                    "implementation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Implementation details or pseudocode for the optimization."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "technique",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Possible optimizations for the recursive solution."
              },
              "iterativeAlternatives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "approach": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The iterative approach (e.g., 'bottom-up dynamic programming', 'stack-based iteration')."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Detailed description of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "advantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Advantages of the iterative approach over recursion."
                    },
                    "disadvantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Disadvantages of the iterative approach."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "timeComplexity": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The time complexity of the recursive solution (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(2^n)')."
                        },
                        "spaceComplexity": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                        },
                        "maxStackDepth": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                        },
                        "worstCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                        },
                        "bestCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "timeComplexity",
                        "spaceComplexity"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Complexity analysis of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "implementation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Pseudocode or implementation details."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "approach",
                    "description",
                    "advantages",
                    "disadvantages"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Alternative iterative solutions."
              },
              "stackOverflowRisk": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "low",
                  "medium",
                  "high"
                ],
                "description": "Risk of stack overflow for typical inputs."
              },
              "inputSizeLimit": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Practical limit on input size before stack overflow."
              },
              "tailRecursionOptimizable": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Whether the recursion can be optimized with tail recursion."
              },
              "invariants": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Properties that remain true throughout the recursive calls."
              },
              "testCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "input": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Description of the test input."
                    },
                    "expectedOutput": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Expected output for this input."
                    },
                    "reasoning": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Why this test case is important."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "input",
                    "expectedOutput"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Key test cases for validating the recursive solution."
              },
              "recursionPattern": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "linear",
                  "binary",
                  "tree",
                  "mutual",
                  "indirect",
                  "nested"
                ],
                "description": "The pattern of recursion used."
              },
              "similarProblems": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Other problems that use similar recursive patterns."
              },
              "learningObjectives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "What can be learned from this recursive analysis."
              },
              "commonMistakes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Common mistakes when implementing this recursive solution."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "problem",
              "baseCases",
              "recursiveCases",
              "terminationConditions"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__scientific_method",
          "description": "Formal hypothesis testing and experimentation following the scientific method.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "observation",
                  "question",
                  "hypothesis",
                  "experiment",
                  "analysis",
                  "conclusion",
                  "iteration"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage in the scientific inquiry process."
              },
              "observation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "An initial observation that sparks inquiry (e.g., 'The new feature has lower engagement than expected')."
              },
              "question": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A specific question that arises from the observation (e.g., 'Why is user engagement low?')."
              },
              "hypothesis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "statement": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A clear, falsifiable statement predicting a relationship between variables (e.g., 'Reducing button size will decrease user conversion rate')."
                  },
                  "variables": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "name": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The name of the variable (e.g., 'user conversion rate', 'website latency')."
                        },
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "independent",
                            "dependent",
                            "controlled",
                            "confounding"
                          ],
                          "description": "The role of the variable in the experiment. Independent: the one you change. Dependent: the one you measure. Controlled: the ones you keep constant."
                        },
                        "operationalization": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "A precise description of how the variable will be measured or manipulated (e.g., 'Latency measured as Time to First Byte in ms', 'Conversion measured by sign-ups per 1000 visitors')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "name",
                        "type"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "An array defining all variables involved in the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "assumptions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Any conditions assumed to be true for the hypothesis to hold (e.g., 'Users notice button size')."
                  },
                  "hypothesisId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for tracking this specific hypothesis."
                  },
                  "confidence": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A prior confidence score (0-1) in the hypothesis before testing.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "domain": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific area of study or context of the hypothesis (e.g., 'UI/UX Optimization')."
                  },
                  "iteration": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "The version number of this hypothesis, for tracking refinements."
                  },
                  "alternativeTo": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of IDs of competing or alternative hypotheses."
                  },
                  "refinementOf": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of a previous, broader hypothesis that this one refines."
                  },
                  "status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "proposed",
                      "testing",
                      "supported",
                      "refuted",
                      "refined"
                    ],
                    "description": "The current lifecycle stage of the hypothesis."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "statement",
                  "variables",
                  "assumptions",
                  "hypothesisId",
                  "confidence",
                  "domain",
                  "iteration",
                  "status"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The formal hypothesis being investigated."
              },
              "experiment": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "design": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A description of the experimental design (e.g., 'A/B Test', 'Repeated Measures Design')."
                  },
                  "methodology": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The step-by-step procedure for conducting the experiment."
                  },
                  "predictions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "if": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific condition or action to be taken in the experiment (e.g., 'If we decrease the button size by 50%')."
                        },
                        "then": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific, measurable outcome expected if the hypothesis is true (e.g., 'then the user conversion rate will drop by at least 5%')."
                        },
                        "else": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "An alternative outcome, which might support a competing hypothesis (e.g., 'else the conversion rate will remain unchanged')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "if",
                        "then"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "The specific, testable predictions derived from the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "experimentId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for this specific experiment."
                  },
                  "hypothesisId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of the hypothesis this experiment is designed to test."
                  },
                  "controlMeasures": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Measures taken to prevent confounding variables from influencing the results (e.g., 'Ensuring both user groups have similar demographics')."
                  },
                  "results": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A summary of the raw data or findings from the experiment."
                  },
                  "outcomeMatched": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "description": "A flag indicating whether the results matched the 'then' part of the prediction."
                  },
                  "unexpectedObservations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Any surprising findings not anticipated by the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "limitations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Factors that may limit the generalizability of the findings (e.g., 'Sample size was small')."
                  },
                  "nextSteps": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Proposed follow-up actions, such as further experiments or analysis."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "design",
                  "methodology",
                  "predictions",
                  "experimentId",
                  "hypothesisId",
                  "controlMeasures"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The design and details of the experiment to test the hypothesis."
              },
              "analysis": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The interpretation of the experimental results and statistical analysis."
              },
              "conclusion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final conclusion drawn from the analysis, stating whether the hypothesis was supported or refuted."
              },
              "inquiryId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for the entire scientific inquiry from observation to conclusion."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of the inquiry process, for tracking cycles of refinement."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether the inquiry requires a subsequent stage."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "stage",
              "inquiryId",
              "iteration",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__sequential_thinking",
          "description": "A detailed tool for dynamic and reflective problem-solving through thoughts. This tool helps analyze problems through a flexible thinking process that can adapt and evolve.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "thought": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The core thinking process or analysis at this stage, forming a coherent narrative.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "thoughtNumber": {
                "type": "integer",
                "description": "The sequential number of the current thought in the series.",
                "minimum": 0
              },
              "totalThoughts": {
                "type": "integer",
                "description": "The total number of thoughts planned for this problem-solving session.",
                "minimum": 0
              },
              "nextThoughtNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another thought is required to continue the process."
              },
              "isRevision": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Indicates if this thought is a revision of a previous one."
              },
              "revisesThought": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "The number of the thought that this one revises, if applicable."
              },
              "branchFromThought": {
                "type": "integer",
                "minimum": 0,
                "description": "The thought number from which a new branch of thinking emerges."
              },
              "branchId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for a specific branch of thought, allowing for parallel exploration."
              },
              "needsMoreThoughts": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Indicates if the current plan needs more thoughts to be added."
              },
              "currentStep": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "stepDescription": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A clear and concise description of the step to be taken."
                  },
                  "recommendedTools": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "toolName": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The name of the recommended tool."
                        },
                        "confidence": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the recommendation.",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 1
                        },
                        "rationale": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The rationale for recommending this tool."
                        },
                        "priority": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "The priority of this tool recommendation."
                        },
                        "alternativeTools": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "A list of alternative tools that could be used."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "toolName",
                        "confidence",
                        "rationale",
                        "priority"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "A list of recommended tools to be used for this step, with confidence scores."
                  },
                  "expectedOutcome": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The expected outcome after completing this step."
                  },
                  "nextStepConditions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Conditions that would trigger the next step or a branch in the thought process."
                  },
                  "stepNumber": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "The sequential number of the current step."
                  },
                  "estimatedDuration": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "An estimation of how long this step might take."
                  },
                  "complexityLevel": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "low",
                      "medium",
                      "high"
                    ],
                    "description": "The assessed complexity level of this step."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "stepDescription",
                  "recommendedTools",
                  "expectedOutcome",
                  "nextStepConditions"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The detailed description of the immediate next step to be executed."
              },
              "previousSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__structured_argumentation",

          "parameters": {

        {
          "name": "pwsh",
          "description": "Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with \"only core types\" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.",

        {
          "name": "schedule_create",
          "description": "Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "title": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes."
              },
              "prompt": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Instruction delivered at each occurrence."
              },
              "rrule": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: \"DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1\""
              },
              "target": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.",
                "enum": [
                  "this_session",
                  "new_once",
                  "new"
                ]
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "title",
              "prompt",
              "rrule",
              "target"
            ]
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "schedule_edit",
          "description": "Update, pause, resume, or delete one scheduled task by id. Deleting does not retract queued messages.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "id": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Task id."
              },
              "action": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "update applies the provided fields, at least one; delete removes the task.",
                "enum": [
                  "update",
                  "delete"
                ]
              },
              "title": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes."
              },
              "prompt": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "New instruction delivered at each occurrence."
              },
              "rrule": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "New recurrence in the schedule_create rrule format."
              },
              "target": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Omit to retain the destination and its creation settings. Providing target replaces them; new_once reserves a different Session. New targets capture this Session's working directory and preset. Choices are the same as schedule_create.",
                "enum": [
                  "this_session",
                  "new_once",
                  "new"
                ]
              },
              "active": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "false pauses the task; true resumes only if its timing has a future occurrence. Otherwise provide a new rrule."
              },
              "expectedUpdatedAt": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "updatedAt from the latest result that returned this task; if the task changed after that result, the result is schedule_conflict and nothing changes."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "id",
              "action"
            ]
          }
        },

        {
          "name": "subagent",
          "description": "Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes. Supply `provider` and `model` together. Omitted values use child defaults, falling back to compatible parent values. When the effective route changes, an omitted `reasoning_effort` uses the model's default.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "cwd": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Initial child working directory. Relative paths use your current directory; omitted inherits it. Later directory changes in either agent are independent."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A short (3-5 word) description of the delegated task, for display."
              },
              "prompt": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The complete, self-contained task for the subagent. It does not share this conversation's context, so include everything it needs."
              },
              "provider": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Child LLM provider id."
              },
              "model": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Model id within that provider."
              },
              "reasoning_effort": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Model-specific reasoning effort id."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "description",
              "prompt"
            ]
          }
        },

          "name": "subagent_fork",

Use this when the subtask builds on this conversation's context — a follow-up analysis, a review, a continuation — without consuming this conversation's context for the work itself. You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.",

# DeepSeek Harness adaptive routing policy

Use the `adaptive-task-router` skill before selecting tools for non-trivial work.

- Classify each request as simple, coding, research, document, automation, reasoning, or multi-step.
- Load only the smallest relevant skill set: at most 5 primary skills and 3 supporting skills.
- For coding tasks, pair implementation guidance with testing and verification when relevant.
- Use direct tools for one-step work; use PTC for multi-step or parallel work.
- For research, use web search; prefer `ag` for current news and broad synthesis; prefer `exa` for URLs, domains, code, docs, APIs, GitHub, and arXiv.
- Keep MCP optional and failure-contained; use bounded retries and fall back when a provider fails.
- Compact large tool output before continuing; preserve errors, paths, citations, and test results.
- Before completion, run the narrowest relevant verification and report the evidence.
- For high-impact architecture, repeated failed attempts, contradictory evidence, or unresolved correctness risk, use the `ask_advisor` tool when configured; send only focused question/goal/constraints/attempts and selected evidence, then verify advice before acting.
- Ask only when ambiguity changes the tool, skill, safety, or execution mode.

</system-reminder>
```

          "name": "mcp__agentic-tools__search_memories",

          "parameters": {

            "required": [

            "additionalProperties": false,
            "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#"

        },

          "parameters": {
