                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of entities included in this bounded context."
                  },
                  "excludedConcepts": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of concepts explicitly excluded from this bounded context."
                  },
                  "interfaces": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of interfaces this bounded context exposes."
                  },
                  "responsibilities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of responsibilities of this bounded context."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "name",
                  "description",
                  "includedEntities"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The bounded context of the domain."
              },
              "assumptions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of assumptions made during the modeling process."
              },
              "stakeholders": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of stakeholders involved in the modeling process."
              },
              "useCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of use cases for the domain."
              },
              "modelValidation": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "completeness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the completeness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "consistency": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the consistency of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "correctness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the correctness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "issues": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of identified issues with the model."
                  },
                  "suggestions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of suggestions for improving the model."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "completeness",
                  "consistency",
                  "correctness"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Validation results for the model."
              },
              "abstractionLevel": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "high",
                  "medium",
                  "low"
                ],
                "description": "The level of abstraction of the model."
              },
              "paradigm": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "object-oriented",
                  "relational",
                  "functional",
                  "event-driven",
                  "service-oriented",
                  "domain-driven"
                ],
                "description": "The modeling paradigm used."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another modeling stage is required."
              },
              "suggestedNextStage": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The suggested next stage in the modeling process."
              },
              "modelingNotes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of notes related to the modeling process."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "domainName",
              "description",
              "modelingId",
              "iteration",
              "stage",
              "entities",
              "abstractionLevel",
              "paradigm",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__mental_model",
          "description": "Tool for creating and analyzing mental models to understand complex problems and systems.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "modelName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the mental model being used (e.g., 'Second-Order Thinking', 'First Principles'). This helps categorize the analysis.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear, specific, and bounded description of the problem being analyzed. A good problem statement is crucial for effective model application. For example, 'How can we reduce user friction in our onboarding flow?' is better than 'Make the app better'.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "steps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A sequential, logical breakdown of how the mental model is applied. Each step should be a clear action or point of analysis, demonstrating the model's framework."
              },
              "reasoning": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The core logic behind the analysis. Explain *why* this model is appropriate for this problem and *how* the steps connect to the model's principles. This is crucial for evaluating the application's quality."
              },
              "conclusion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final, actionable insight or decision. It should be a direct synthesis of the preceding steps and reasoning."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "modelName",
              "problem"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__metacognitive_monitoring",
          "description": "Self-assessment of knowledge and reasoning quality for improved metacognition.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "task": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The overall task or problem being addressed."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "knowledge-assessment",
                  "planning",
                  "execution",
                  "monitoring",
                  "evaluation",
                  "reflection"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the metacognitive process."
              },
              "knowledgeAssessment": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "domain": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific domain or topic being assessed."
                  },
                  "knowledgeLevel": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "expert",
                      "proficient",
                      "familiar",
                      "basic",
                      "minimal",
                      "none"
                    ],
                    "description": "The self-assessed level of knowledge in this domain."
                  },
                  "confidenceScore": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed knowledge level.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "supportingEvidence": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Evidence to support the assessed knowledge level."
                  },
                  "knownLimitations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of known limitations or gaps in knowledge."
                  },
                  "relevantTrainingCutoff": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The date of the last relevant training or data cutoff."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "domain",
                  "knowledgeLevel",
                  "confidenceScore",
                  "supportingEvidence",
                  "knownLimitations"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "An assessment of the knowledge required for the task."
              },
              "claims": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "claim": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific claim being assessed."
                    },
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "fact",
                        "inference",
                        "speculation",
                        "uncertain"
                      ],
                      "description": "The assessed status of the claim."
                    },
                    "confidenceScore": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed status of the claim.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "evidenceBasis": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The evidence supporting the assessment of the claim."
                    },
                    "falsifiabilityCriteria": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Criteria that could be used to falsify the claim."
                    },
                    "alternativeInterpretations": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of alternative interpretations of the evidence."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "claim",
                    "status",
                    "confidenceScore",
                    "evidenceBasis"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of claims being made and assessed."
              },
              "reasoningSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "step": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific step in the reasoning process being assessed."
                    },
                    "potentialBiases": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of potential cognitive biases that may be influencing the reasoning."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of assumptions being made in this reasoning step."
                    },
                    "logicalValidity": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the logical validity of the reasoning step.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "inferenceStrength": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the strength of the inference.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "step",
                    "potentialBiases",
                    "assumptions",
                    "logicalValidity",
                    "inferenceStrength"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of reasoning steps being assessed."
              },
              "overallConfidence": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "An overall confidence score (0-1) in the ability to complete the task successfully.",
                "minimum": 0,
                "maximum": 1
              },
              "uncertaintyAreas": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of areas where there is significant uncertainty."
              },
              "recommendedApproach": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The recommended approach to address the task, given the metacognitive assessment."
              },
              "monitoringId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this monitoring session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this monitoring session."
              },
              "suggestedAssessments": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "knowledge",
                    "claim",
                    "reasoning",
                    "overall"
                  ]
                },
                "description": "A list of suggested next assessments."
              },
              "previousSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A record of the steps that have already been completed."
              },
              "remainingSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A high-level list of the steps that are yet to be taken."
              },
              "toolUsageHistory": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "toolName": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the tool that was used."
                    },
                    "usedAt": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The timestamp at which the tool was used."
                    },
                    "effectivenessScore": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score indicating the effectiveness of the tool."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "toolName",
                    "usedAt"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A log of the tools that have been used so far, along with their effectiveness."
              },
              "nextAssessmentNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another assessment is required."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "task",
              "stage",
              "overallConfidence",
              "uncertaintyAreas",
              "recommendedApproach",
              "monitoringId",
              "iteration",
              "nextAssessmentNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__recursive_thinking",
          "description": "Applying recursive strategies to solve problems with base and recursive cases, including optimizations.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and comprehensive description of the problem to be solved recursively."

              "baseCases": {
                "type": "array",

                  "type": "object",

                      "type": "string",

                      "type": "string",

                    "solution"

                  "additionalProperties": false
                },

              "recursiveCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the recursive case."

                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that defines when this recursive case applies."
                    },
                    "decomposition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the problem is broken down into smaller subproblems."
                    },
                    "recombination": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the solutions to subproblems are combined."
                    },
                    "reductionFactor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How much the problem size is reduced in each recursive call."
                    },
                    "examples": {
                      "type": "array",

                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Concrete examples of inputs that trigger this recursive case."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [

                    "decomposition",
                    "recombination"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The recursive cases that break down the problem."
              },
              "terminationConditions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "All conditions under which the recursion will terminate."
              },
              "complexityAnalysis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "timeComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The time complexity of the recursive solution (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(2^n)')."
                  },
                  "spaceComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                  },
                  "maxStackDepth": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                  },
                  "worstCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                  },
                  "bestCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "timeComplexity",
                  "spaceComplexity"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Detailed complexity analysis of the recursive solution."
              },
              "optimizations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "technique": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The optimization technique (e.g., 'memoization', 'tail recursion')."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Description of how the optimization works."
                    },
                    "complexityImprovement": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the optimization improves complexity."
                    },
                    "tradeoffs": {
                      "type": "array",

                        "type": "string"
                      },

                  "properties": {
                    "approach": {

                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Detailed description of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "advantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Advantages of the iterative approach over recursion."

                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },

                    },

                          "type": "string",

                        },
                        "spaceComplexity": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                        },
                        "maxStackDepth": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                        },
                        "worstCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                        },
                        "bestCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "timeComplexity",
                        "spaceComplexity"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Complexity analysis of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "implementation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Pseudocode or implementation details."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "approach",
                    "description",
                    "advantages",
                    "disadvantages"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Alternative iterative solutions."
              },
              "stackOverflowRisk": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "low",
                  "medium",

              },

              "invariants": {

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__scientific_method",
          "description": "Formal hypothesis testing and experimentation following the scientific method.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "observation",
                  "question",
                  "hypothesis",
                  "experiment",
                  "analysis",
                  "conclusion",
                  "iteration"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage in the scientific inquiry process."
              },
              "observation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "An initial observation that sparks inquiry (e.g., 'The new feature has lower engagement than expected')."
              },
              "question": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A specific question that arises from the observation (e.g., 'Why is user engagement low?')."
              },
              "hypothesis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "statement": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A clear, falsifiable statement predicting a relationship between variables (e.g., 'Reducing button size will decrease user conversion rate')."
                  },
                  "variables": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "name": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The name of the variable (e.g., 'user conversion rate', 'website latency')."
                        },
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "independent",
                            "dependent",
                            "controlled",
                            "confounding"
                          ],
                          "description": "The role of the variable in the experiment. Independent: the one you change. Dependent: the one you measure. Controlled: the ones you keep constant."
                        },
                        "operationalization": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "A precise description of how the variable will be measured or manipulated (e.g., 'Latency measured as Time to First Byte in ms', 'Conversion measured by sign-ups per 1000 visitors')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "name",
                        "type"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "An array defining all variables involved in the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "assumptions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Any conditions assumed to be true for the hypothesis to hold (e.g., 'Users notice button size')."
                  },
                  "hypothesisId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for tracking this specific hypothesis."
                  },
                  "confidence": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A prior confidence score (0-1) in the hypothesis before testing.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "domain": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific area of study or context of the hypothesis (e.g., 'UI/UX Optimization')."
                  },
                  "iteration": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "The version number of this hypothesis, for tracking refinements."
                  },
                  "alternativeTo": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of IDs of competing or alternative hypotheses."
                  },
                  "refinementOf": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of a previous, broader hypothesis that this one refines."
                  },
                  "status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "proposed",
                      "testing",
                      "supported",
                      "refuted",
                      "refined"
                    ],
                    "description": "The current lifecycle stage of the hypothesis."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "statement",
                  "variables",
                  "assumptions",
                  "hypothesisId",
                  "confidence",
                  "domain",
                  "iteration",
                  "status"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The formal hypothesis being investigated."
              },
              "experiment": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "design": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A description of the experimental design (e.g., 'A/B Test', 'Repeated Measures Design')."
                  },
                  "methodology": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The step-by-step procedure for conducting the experiment."
                  },
                  "predictions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "if": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific condition or action to be taken in the experiment (e.g., 'If we decrease the button size by 50%')."
                        },
                        "then": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific, measurable outcome expected if the hypothesis is true (e.g., 'then the user conversion rate will drop by at least 5%')."
                        },
                        "else": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "An alternative outcome, which might support a competing hypothesis (e.g., 'else the conversion rate will remain unchanged')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "if",
                        "then"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "The specific, testable predictions derived from the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "experimentId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for this specific experiment."
                  },
                  "hypothesisId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of the hypothesis this experiment is designed to test."
                  },
                  "controlMeasures": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Measures taken to prevent confounding variables from influencing the results (e.g., 'Ensuring both user groups have similar demographics')."
                  },
                  "results": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A summary of the raw data or findings from the experiment."
                  },
                  "outcomeMatched": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "description": "A flag indicating whether the results matched the 'then' part of the prediction."
                  },
                  "unexpectedObservations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Any surprising findings not anticipated by the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "limitations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Factors that may limit the generalizability of the findings (e.g., 'Sample size was small')."
                  },
                  "nextSteps": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Proposed follow-up actions, such as further experiments or analysis."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "design",
                  "methodology",
                  "predictions",
                  "experimentId",
                  "hypothesisId",
                  "controlMeasures"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The design and details of the experiment to test the hypothesis."
              },
              "analysis": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The interpretation of the experimental results and statistical analysis."
              },
              "conclusion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final conclusion drawn from the analysis, stating whether the hypothesis was supported or refuted."
              },
              "inquiryId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for the entire scientific inquiry from observation to conclusion."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of the inquiry process, for tracking cycles of refinement."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether the inquiry requires a subsequent stage."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "stage",
              "inquiryId",
              "iteration",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__sequential_thinking",

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__structured_argumentation",
          "description": "Dialectical reasoning and argument analysis for structured debates and logical reasoning.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "claim": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The central claim or assertion being made."
              },
              "premises": {
                "type": "array",

List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.",

        {
          "name": "pwsh",
          "description": "Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with \"only core types\" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: \"ls\" → \"List files in current directory\"; \"git status\" → \"Show working tree status\"; \"Get-Process\" → \"List running processes\"."
              },
              "command": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The PowerShell command to execute."
              },
              "timeoutMs": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed."
              },
              "workdir": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it."
              },
              "run_in_background": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies."
              },
              "sandbox_permissions": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.",
                "enum": [

              },
              "justification": {
                "type": "string",

              }

            "required": [
              "description",
              "command"
            ]
          }

          "name": "schedule_create",
          "description": "Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "title": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes."
              },
              "prompt": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Instruction delivered at each occurrence."
              },
              "rrule": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: \"DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1\""
              },
              "target": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.",
                "enum": [
                  "this_session",
                  "new_once",
                  "new"
                ]

              "prompt",
              "rrule",
              "target"
            ]

        {
          "name": "subagent",
          "description": "Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes. Supply `provider` and `model` together. Omitted values use child defaults, falling back to compatible parent values. When the effective route changes, an omitted `reasoning_effort` uses the model's default.",

You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its id. The runtime notifies you when it finishes. The child reports results with `send_message`; use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes.",

        {
          "name": "workflow",
          "description": "Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.\n\nScript-body hooks:\n- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.\n- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.\n- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.\n- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.\n\nMisused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "script": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result."
              },
              "meta": {
                "type": "object",
                "description": "The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.",
                "additionalProperties": true,
                "properties": {
                  "name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Short kebab-case workflow name."
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "One-line description of what the workflow does."
                  },
                  "whenToUse": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Optional guidance on when this workflow applies."
                  },
                  "phases": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "description": "Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "additionalProperties": true,
                      "properties": {

  200: 
  201:   Mở PowerShell **Run as Administrator** trên máy host:
  202: 
  203:   ```powershell
  204:   Add-WindowsCapability -Online -Name OpenSSH.Server~~~~0.0.1.0
  205:   Start-Service sshd
  206:   Set-Service -Name sshd -StartupType Automatic
  207:   Get-Service sshd
  208:   Get-NetFirewallRule -Name OpenSSH-Server-In-TCP -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  209:   ```
  210: 
  211:   Nếu capability đã có, chỉ cần start service và đặt startup. Không mở port SSH ra Wi-Fi/public interface ngoài rule cần thiết cho Tailscale.
  212: 
  213: - [ ] **Step 1.3: Cấu hình SSH key-only an toàn.**
  214: 
  215:   User tạo public key ở máy điều khiển nếu chưa có, chép **public key** vào authorized keys trên Windows host, thử login bằng key trước rồi mới tắt password authentication. Không gửi private key cho assistant.
  216: 
  217:   Kiểm tra từ máy điều khiển:
  218: 
  219:   ```bash
  220:   ssh -o PreferredAuthentications=publickey -o PasswordAuthentication=no <windows-user>@<tailscale-ip> hostname
  221:   ```
  222: 
  223:   `<windows-user>` và `<tailscale-ip>` phải lấy từ output thật; không đoán hoặc commit vào repo.
  224: 
  225: - [ ] **Step 1.4: Tạo một VM Debian smoke-test.**
  226: 
  227:   User tạo một VM Debian 12 duy nhất, một NIC trên bất kỳ vmnet private tạm thời, IP tĩnh trong subnet đó, SSH key-only và user `ops`. Chưa cài ứng dụng.
  228: 
  229: - [ ] **Step 1.5: Kiểm ProxyJump từ máy điều khiển và từ WSL.**
  230: 
  231:   Từ máy điều khiển:
  232: 
  233:   ```bash
  234:   ssh -J <windows-user>@<tailscale-ip> ops@<debian-smoke-ip> hostname
  235:   ```
  236: 
  237:   Từ WSL control plane:
  238: 
  239:   ```bash
  240:   ssh -J <windows-user>@<tailscale-ip> ops@<debian-smoke-ip> hostname
  241:   ```
  242: 
  243:   User ghi kết quả `direct` hoặc `DERP` từ `tailscale status`; không dùng kết quả DERP cho benchmark timing.
  244: 
  245: - [ ] **Step 1.6: Kiểm đường điều khiển VM bằng `vmrun`.**
  246: 
  247:   Từ máy điều khiển hoặc WSL gọi qua Windows SSH, user kiểm tra:
  248: 
  249:   ```bash
  250:   ssh <windows-user>@<tailscale-ip> '"C:\Program Files (x86)\VMware\VMware Workstation\vmrun.exe" list'
  251:   ```
  252: 
  253:   Chỉ chạy `start`/`stop` sau khi user xác nhận đúng đường dẫn `.vmx`; không dùng wildcard.
  254: 
  255: - [ ] **Step 1.7: Ghi interface map tạm thời.**
  256: 
  257:   Assistant tạo `docs/interfaces.md` sau khi nhận các giá trị đã che secret. File phải ghi hostname, Tailscale IP, vmnet mapping, Linux VM IP, phiên bản VMware/OPNsense/Debian và thời điểm xác nhận.
  258: 
  259: **Pass P1:** SSH vào Windows host bằng key, ProxyJump vào Debian smoke-test từ WSL, và `vmrun list` trả kết quả đúng.
  260: 
  261: **Fail P1:** Dừng. Chọn một trong hai phương án:
  262: 
  263: 1. Hai người thao tác trực tiếp trên máy VMware host, giữ nguyên lab 14 test nhưng bỏ remote control.
  264: 2. Sửa Windows OpenSSH/Tailscale/VMnet rồi lặp lại tối đa 60 phút.
  265: 
  266: Không dựng 12 VM khi P1 chưa pass.
  267: 
  268: ---
  269: 
  270: ## Task 2: Tạo sáu mạng VMware và IP plan
  271: 
  272: **Owner:** USER trên VMware GUI; ASSISTANT kiểm tra mapping và tính nhất quán.
  273: 
  274: **Mục tiêu:** Tạo topology L2 đúng trước khi cài dịch vụ.
  275: 
  276: - [ ] **Step 2.1: Mở Virtual Network Editor với quyền admin.**
  277: 
  278:   User tạo sáu custom host-only/private network. Tên nội bộ VMware có thể là VMnet2-VMnet7; tên logic trong repo phải theo bảng này:
  279: 
  280:   | Logic | Subnet | DHCP | Host adapter | Dùng cho |
  281:   |---|---|---|---|---|
  282:   | `wan` | `10.0.0.0/24` | Off | On | OPNsense WAN, attacker, sensor |
  283:   | `sync` | `192.168.50.0/24` | Off | Optional/on nếu cần debug | pfsync/cfgsync chỉ giữa OPNsense |
  284:   | `dmz_front` | `192.168.20.0/24` | Off | On | LB và OPNsense |
  285:   | `dmz_app` | `192.168.21.0/24` | Off | On | web và OPNsense |
  286:   | `trusted` | `192.168.30.0/24` | Off | On | PostgreSQL và OPNsense |
  287:   | `mgmt` | `192.168.99.0/24` | Off | On | OPNsense GUI, obs, ca |
  288: 
  289:   Không bật NAT hoặc bridged. Không dùng cùng một VMnet cho WAN và DMZ.
  290: 
  291: - [ ] **Step 2.2: Đặt địa chỉ tĩnh theo topology.**
  292: 
  293:   Dùng bảng sau làm nguồn tham chiếu; địa chỉ interface OPNsense và host adapter phải được ghi lại sau khi user cấu hình:
  294: 
  295:   | Node | WAN | SYNC | DMZ-FRONT | DMZ-APP | TRUSTED | MGMT |
  296:   |---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
  297:   | `opns1` | `10.0.0.1` | `192.168.50.1` | `192.168.20.1` | `192.168.21.1` | `192.168.30.1` | `192.168.99.1` |
  298:   | `opns2` | `10.0.0.2` | `192.168.50.2` | `192.168.20.2` | `192.168.21.2` | `192.168.30.2` | `192.168.99.2` |
  299:   | CARP VIP | `10.0.0.100` | n/a | `192.168.20.100` | `192.168.21.100` nếu cần | `192.168.30.100` nếu cần | `192.168.99.100` |
  300:   | `lb1/lb2` | n/a | n/a | `.10/.11` | n/a | n/a | stats qua MGMT nếu cần |
  301:   | `web1/web2` | n/a | n/a | n/a | `.21/.22` | n/a | n/a |
  302:   | `pg1/pg2` | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | `.11/.12` | n/a |
  303:   | `obs` | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | `.30` |
  304:   | `ca` | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | `.31` |
  305:   | `attacker` | `.20` | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a |
  306:   | `sensor` | `.21` | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a | n/a |
  307: 
  308:   `192.168.50.1/.2` là địa chỉ sync riêng; không dùng `10.0.0.2` cho pfsync/cfgsync. Đây là điểm cần sửa so với đoạn tham chiếu trong HTML.
  309: 
  310: - [ ] **Step 2.3: Tạo host adapter và kiểm từ Windows.**
  311: 
  312:   User chạy:
  313: 
  314:   ```powershell
  315:   Get-NetAdapter -Name 'VMware Network Adapter*'
  316:   Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 |
  317:     Where-Object InterfaceAlias -like 'VMware Network Adapter*' |
  318:     Format-Table InterfaceAlias,IPAddress,PrefixLength
  319:   ```
  320: 
  321:   Ping/TCP tới smoke-test VM trên từng subnet có VM. Không dùng ping làm bằng chứng cho subnet mà firewall được thiết kế để drop ICMP; dùng `Test-NetConnection -ComputerName <ip> -Port <port>` khi phù hợp.
  322: 
  323: - [ ] **Step 2.4: Kiểm promiscuous capture.**
  324: 
  325:   User chỉ làm trên vmnet WAN private. Gắn hai VM test cùng segment, chạy tcpdump ở sensor và tạo traffic từ attacker. Nếu không bắt được traffic của VM khác, user kiểm tra VMware security/promiscuous setting và chỉ tiếp tục sau khi ghi rõ giới hạn.
  326: 
  327: - [ ] **Step 2.5: Assistant đối chiếu topology.**
  328: 
  329:   Assistant kiểm tra không có node attacker trên DMZ-FRONT/DMZ-APP/TRUSTED, không có NIC thừa, không có subnet trùng và host adapter đủ để ProxyJump.
  330: 
  331: **Pass P2:** Sáu mạng tồn tại, DHCP/NAT/bridged sai đều tắt, host reachability đúng, sensor capture smoke-test có bằng chứng.
  332: 
  333: **Fail P2:** Không cài dịch vụ. Giữ một vmnet test duy nhất hoặc sửa VMware network editor. Không cố giải quyết L2 bằng Tailscale route advertisement.
  334: 
  335: ---
  336: 
  337: ## Task 3: Dựng VM theo profile, không bật cả 12 VM cùng lúc
  338: 
  339: **Owner:** USER tạo VM/snapshot; ASSISTANT chuẩn bị inventory sau khi VM có địa chỉ.
  340: 
  341: **Mục tiêu:** Giữ RAM trong giới hạn 32 GB và có rollback sạch.
  342: 
  343: - [ ] **Step 3.1: Chuẩn bị template Debian 12.**
  344: 
  345:   User cài Debian 12 minimal một lần, cập nhật package, tạo `ops`, SSH key-only, timezone/NTP và tắt service không cần. Chụp snapshot `clean-template`. Không đặt secret dự án vào template.
  346: 
  347: - [ ] **Step 3.2: Tạo core profile trước.**
  348: 
  349:   Bật theo thứ tự:
  350: 
  351:   1. `opns1`, `opns2`
  352:   2. `lb1`, `lb2`
  353:   3. `web1`, `web2`
  354:   4. `pg1`, `pg2`
  355: 
  356:   Dùng RAM tham chiếu: OPNsense 2 GB/node, LB 512 MB/node, web 1 GB/node, PostgreSQL 1.5 GB/node. Nếu host bắt đầu paging mạnh, tắt LB/web/DB không liên quan thay vì tăng WSL limit.
  357: 
  358: - [ ] **Step 3.3: Tạo observe profile.**
  359: 
  360:   Thêm `obs` khoảng 2.5 GB và `ca` khoảng 512 MB. Chỉ bật sau khi core profile pass. Tổng steady state mục tiêu khoảng 13.5-15 GB VM RAM tùy dịch vụ.
  361: 
  362: - [ ] **Step 3.4: Tạo attack profile.**
  363: 
  364:   Thêm `attacker` khoảng 2 GB và `sensor` khoảng 1.5 GB chỉ trong phiên test. Tắt sau test. Không chạy attack profile cùng browser/IDE nặng nếu host bắt đầu dùng memory compression mạnh.
  365: 
  366: - [ ] **Step 3.5: Gắn NIC theo node.**
  367: 
  368:   Mỗi OPNsense có 6 NIC logic: WAN, SYNC, DMZ-FRONT, DMZ-APP, TRUSTED, MGMT. Linux service VM chỉ gắn đúng vùng cần dùng; không gắn thêm WAN cho web/DB.
  369: 
  370: - [ ] **Step 3.6: Chụp snapshot.**
  371: 
  372:   Chụp `clean` sau khi OS/NIC/IP/NTP/SSH cơ bản pass. Chụp thêm `before-carp`, `before-policy`, `IPS-off`, `before-db-failover` trước các phase tương ứng.
  373: 
  374: - [ ] **Step 3.7: Cập nhật inventory.**
  375: 
  376:   Assistant tạo `inventory/hosts.yml` và `docs/interfaces.md` từ mapping user cung cấp. Không hardcode Tailscale IP hoặc secret.
  377: 
  378: **Pass P3:** Core VM có đúng NIC/subnet, SSH tới Linux VM qua ProxyJump, OPNsense console/GUI truy cập được, snapshot `clean` tồn tại, `vmrun list` hiển thị đúng VM đang bật.
  379: 
  380: **Fail P3:** Xóa khỏi inventory các VM chưa cần, không xóa file VM hoặc snapshot nếu chưa được user xác nhận. Tiếp tục với vertical slice `opns1 -> lb1 -> web1`.
  381: 
  382: ---
  383: 
  384: ## Task 4: Cấu hình OPNsense một node rồi mới HA
  385: 
  386: **Owner:** USER trên OPNsense console/GUI; ASSISTANT kiểm tra policy/topology và chuẩn bị checklist.
  387: 
  388: **Mục tiêu:** Có routing/firewall cơ bản trước, sau đó mới bật CARP/pfsync/cfgsync.
  389: 
  390: - [ ] **Step 4.1: Cấu hình `opns1` interface mapping.**
  391: 
  392:   Trên console OPNsense, map đúng NIC theo MAC/VMware order; đặt description `wan`, `sync`, `dmz_front`, `dmz_app`, `trusted`, `mgmt`. Không tin thứ tự `em0/em1` nếu chưa đối chiếu MAC.
  393: 
  394: - [ ] **Step 4.2: Đặt IP/gateway và HTTPS GUI.**
  395: 
  396:   Cấu hình IP theo bảng P2, bật HTTPS GUI trên MGMT, tạo user admin riêng, lưu config backup cục bộ. Chưa mở GUI trên WAN.
  397: 
  398: - [ ] **Step 4.3: Tạo policy tối thiểu thủ công.**
  399: 
  400:   Cho phép WAN DNAT TCP/443 tới LB VIP, cho phép các kết nối bootstrap cần thiết, block WAN tới TRUSTED/MGMT, block DMZ-APP/TRUSTED egress WAN. Ghi mỗi rule bằng một ID tạm tương ứng `POL-001`...`POL-005`.
  401: 
  402: - [ ] **Step 4.4: Tạo dịch vụ giả trên `lb1`.**
  403: 
  404:   User chạy trên LB test:
  405: 
  406:   ```bash
  407:   sudo nc -lvnp 443
  408:   ```
  409: 
  410:   Từ attacker hoặc máy test trên WAN, kiểm tra DNAT bằng `curl -k`/`nc` phù hợp. Không kiểm từ Internet.
  411: 
  412: - [ ] **Step 4.5: Cấu hình `opns2` giống version/interface order.**
  413: 
  414:   Cài đúng phiên bản OPNsense, map NIC bằng MAC, đặt IP node riêng và sync IP `192.168.50.2`. Chụp `before-carp` trước khi bật HA.
  415: 
  416: - [ ] **Step 4.6: Bật CARP từng zone.**
  417: 
  418:   Tạo VIP với vhid khác nhau cho WAN, DMZ-FRONT, DMZ-APP, TRUSTED và MGMT; node master `advskew 0`, backup `advskew 100`; tắt preempt để tránh flap khi node hồi.
  419: 
  420: - [ ] **Step 4.7: Bật pfsync trên SYNC.**
  421: 
  422:   pfsync chỉ chạy qua `192.168.50.0/24`, không qua WAN. User xác nhận bằng console:
  423: 
  424:   ```text
  425:   ifconfig carp
  426:   tcpdump -i <sync-interface> -nn proto 240
  427:   ```
  428: 
  429:   Với pfsync FreeBSD, proto 240 là giá trị cần kiểm tra; nếu phiên bản hiển thị khác, ghi output thực tế thay vì đoán.
  430: 
  431: - [ ] **Step 4.8: Bật cfgsync có chủ động.**
  432: 
  433:   Tạo user sync quyền tối thiểu, snapshot trước lần sync đầu, tắt auto-sync trong lúc sửa tay. Kiểm tra sửa trên backup không bị ghi đè im lặng và drift có cảnh báo.
  434: 
  435: - [ ] **Step 4.9: Chạy test HA tối thiểu.**
  436: 
  437:   - Giữ một SSH/iperf session qua VIP.
  438:   - Tắt node master bằng thao tác user đã xác nhận.
  439:   - Đo thời gian VIP đổi master.
  440:   - Cắt vmnet-sync, xác nhận không có hai MASTER.
  441:   - Khôi phục node và kiểm preempt không gây flap.
  442: 
  443: **Pass P4:** T-04, T-05 và phần nền của T-06 có số liệu; một CARP master mỗi VIP; session dài và state sync hoạt động.
  444: 
  445: **Fail P4:** Tắt cfgsync và rollback `before-carp`; giữ một OPNsense để làm vertical slice. Không bật IPS hoặc DB failover.
  446: 
  447: ---
  448: 
  449: ## Task 5: Tạo repo control plane và policy-as-code
  450: 
  451: **Owner:** ASSISTANT viết artifact; USER cung cấp giá trị môi trường và chạy lệnh có quyền/network.
  452: 
  453: **Mục tiêu:** Biến YAML thành nguồn chân lý, apply idempotent và có validator trước khi triển khai dịch vụ.
  454: 
  455: - [ ] **Step 5.1: Assistant khởi tạo cấu trúc repo.**
  456: 
  457:   Tạo các file trong phần File structure: `.gitignore`, `Makefile`, `ansible.cfg`, inventory, policy schema, `scripts/validate_policy.py`, test self-check và `docs/checkpoints.md`.
  458: 
  459: - [ ] **Step 5.2: Assistant viết policy YAML tối thiểu.**
  460: 
  461:   `policy/zones.yml` phải có:
  462: 
  463:   ```yaml
  464:   zones:
  465:     wan: {net: 10.0.0.0/24, iface: wan}
  466:     dmz_front: {net: 192.168.20.0/24, iface: opt1}
  467:     dmz_app: {net: 192.168.21.0/24, iface: opt2}
  468:     trusted: {net: 192.168.30.0/24, iface: opt3}
  469:     mgmt: {net: 192.168.99.0/24, iface: opt4}
  470: 
  471:   aliases:
  472:     LB_VIP: {type: host, items: [192.168.20.100]}
  473:     APP_NODES: {type: network, items: [192.168.21.21/32, 192.168.21.22/32]}
  474:     DB_VIP: {type: host, items: [192.168.30.100]}
  475:     MGMT_ONLY: {type: network, items: [192.168.99.0/24]}
  476: 
  477:   rules:
  478:     - id: POL-001
  479:       desc: Public HTTPS vao LB VIP
  480:       zone: wan -> dmz_front
  481:       proto: tcp
  482:       dst: LB_VIP
  483:       dport: [443]
  484:       action: pass
  485:       log: true
  486:       test: T-07
  487:       reason: Public entrypoint only
  488:   ```
  489: 
  490:   Các rule còn lại phải thêm trước khi apply production: web-to-DB, WAN-to-DB block, DMZ/TRUSTED egress block, SSH MGMT-only, observability access và NAT.
  491: 
  492: - [ ] **Step 5.3: User cài dependency tối thiểu trong distro control plane.**
  493: 
  494:   Assistant đưa lệnh cụ thể theo distro đã chọn. User xác nhận cài package/network. Tối thiểu cần Python, pipx hoặc venv, Ansible, `yamllint`, `pytest`, `gitleaks` và OpenSSH client. Không cài Docker/Podman nếu không có service cần container.
  495: 
  496: - [ ] **Step 5.4: User bật API OPNsense và tạo credential tối thiểu.**
  497: 
  498:   User tạo API user/key/secret trên OPNsense GUI, lưu bằng Ansible Vault hoặc secret manager cục bộ. Không gửi key/secret cho assistant. Chỉ gửi:
  499: 
  500:   - phiên bản OPNsense;
  501:   - HTTP status;
  502:   - endpoint path;
  503:   - tên field JSON sau khi che giá trị;
  504:   - thông báo lỗi đã loại credential.
  505: 
  506: - [ ] **Step 5.5: User xác nhận endpoint API trong 30 phút.**
  507: 
  508:   Chạy curl cục bộ với biến môi trường, không ghi command có secret vào shell history nếu có thể:
  509: 
  510:   ```bash
  511:   curl -k -u "$OPNS_API_KEY:$OPNS_API_SECRET" \
  512:     'https://<opns-mgmt-ip>/api/firewall/alias/searchAlias'
  513:   curl -k -u "$OPNS_API_KEY:$OPNS_API_SECRET" \
  514:     -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  515:     -d '{"alias":{"name":"LAB_PROBE","type":"host","content":"192.0.2.1"}}' \
  516:     'https://<opns-mgmt-ip>/api/firewall/alias/addItem'
  517:   curl -k -u "$OPNS_API_KEY:$OPNS_API_SECRET" \
  518:     'https://<opns-mgmt-ip>/api/firewall/filter/apply'
  519:   ```
  520: 
  521:   Endpoint cuối cùng phải lấy theo API docs/version thực tế. Nếu `LAB_PROBE` được tạo, user xóa nó bằng GUI/API sau khi kiểm chứng.
  522: 
  523: - [ ] **Step 5.6: Assistant viết renderer sau khi API contract được xác nhận.**
  524: 
  525:   Renderer phải:
  526: 
  527:   - map rule theo `POLICY-ID`, không theo vị trí;
  528:   - chạy lần hai không tạo duplicate;
  529:   - xóa rule không còn trong YAML;
  530:   - validate alias trước rule;
  531:   - dry-run/diff trước apply;
  532:   - apply rồi post-check counters/state;
  533:   - không log credential hoặc response chứa secret.
  534: 
  535: - [ ] **Step 5.7: Assistant viết validator 24 combo.**
