                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of potential cognitive biases this persona may have (e.g., 'Confirmation Bias', 'Optimism Bias')."
                    },
                    "communication": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "style": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The communication style of the persona (e.g., 'Socratic', 'data-driven', 'narrative-focused')."
                        },
                        "tone": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The communication tone of the persona (e.g., 'skeptical', 'supportive', 'formal')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "style",
                        "tone"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "The communication style and tone of the persona."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "id",
                    "name",
                    "expertise",
                    "background",
                    "perspective",
                    "biases",
                    "communication"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The set of diverse personas participating in the reasoning process."
              },
              "contributions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "personaId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the persona making the contribution."
                    },
                    "content": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The substance of the contribution, such as an idea, question, or piece of evidence."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "observation",
                        "question",
                        "insight",
                        "concern",
                        "suggestion",
                        "challenge",
                        "synthesis"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of contribution, which frames its intent."
                    },
                    "confidence": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the validity or importance of the contribution.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "referenceIds": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of IDs of other contributions this one builds upon, challenges, or refers to."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "personaId",
                    "content",
                    "type",
                    "confidence"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A log of all contributions made during the session."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "problem-definition",
                  "ideation",
                  "critique",
                  "integration",
                  "decision",
                  "reflection"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the collaborative reasoning process, guiding the nature of contributions."
              },
              "activePersonaId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The ID of the persona who is currently expected to contribute."
              },
              "nextPersonaId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The ID of the persona designated to contribute next, guiding the conversation flow."
              },
              "consensusPoints": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of key points or decisions on which all personas have reached agreement."
              },
              "disagreements": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "topic": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific topic or point of contention."
                    },
                    "positions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "personaId": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "The ID of the persona advocating for this position."
                          },
                          "position": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "A clear statement of the position taken in the disagreement."
                          },
                          "arguments": {
                            "type": "array",
                            "items": {
                              "type": "string"
                            },
                            "description": "The key arguments and evidence supporting this position."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "personaId",
                          "position",
                          "arguments"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "The different positions taken by personas in the disagreement."
                    },
                    "resolution": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "type": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "consensus",
                            "compromise",
                            "integration",
                            "tabled"
                          ],
                          "description": "The method by which the disagreement was resolved."
                        },
                        "description": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "A summary of the resolution and the reasoning behind it."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "type",
                        "description"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "The outcome of the attempt to resolve the disagreement."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "topic",
                    "positions"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of active or resolved disagreements that have occurred."
              },
              "keyInsights": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of significant insights that have emerged from the discussion."
              },
              "openQuestions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of unresolved questions that require further discussion or information."
              },
              "finalRecommendation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final, synthesized recommendation or decision resulting from the session."
              },
              "sessionId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this collaborative reasoning session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The turn number or iteration of the session, for tracking progress."
              },
              "suggestedContributionTypes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string",
                  "enum": [
                    "observation",
                    "question",
                    "insight",
                    "concern",
                    "suggestion",
                    "challenge",
                    "synthesis"
                  ]
                },
                "description": "A list of suggested types for the next contribution to guide the active persona."
              },
              "nextContributionNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether the session is awaiting another contribution to proceed."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "topic",
              "personas",
              "contributions",
              "stage",
              "activePersonaId",
              "sessionId",
              "iteration",
              "nextContributionNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__critical_thinking",
          "description": "Systematic evaluation of arguments, assumptions, and potential issues to improve reasoning quality.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "subject": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The code, design, requirement, or concept being critically analyzed."
              },
              "analysisId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this critical thinking session."
              },
              "context": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The broader context or background relevant to the analysis."
              },
              "objectives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "The specific objectives or goals of this critical analysis."
              },
              "methodology": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The approach or framework used for the critical analysis."
              },
              "potentialIssues": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the issue."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the potential issue or flaw."
                    },
                    "severity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high",
                        "critical"
                      ],
                      "description": "The severity level of the issue."
                    },
                    "category": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "logic",
                        "implementation",
                        "design",
                        "security",
                        "performance",
                        "usability",
                        "maintainability"
                      ],
                      "description": "The category of the issue."
                    },
                    "evidence": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Evidence supporting the existence of this issue."
                    },
                    "likelihood": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The probability (0-1) that this issue will actually occur.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "impact": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The potential impact if this issue manifests."
                    },
                    "mitigation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Suggested approaches to mitigate or resolve this issue."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "severity",
                    "category",
                    "likelihood"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A structured list of potential issues or flaws identified."
              },
              "edgeCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the edge case."
                    },
                    "scenario": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A description of the edge case scenario."
                    },
                    "conditions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "The specific conditions that trigger this edge case."
                    },
                    "expectedBehavior": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "What should happen in this edge case."
                    },
                    "currentBehavior": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "What currently happens (if known)."
                    },
                    "testability": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "easy",
                        "moderate",
                        "difficult",
                        "untestable"
                      ],
                      "description": "How easy it is to test this edge case."
                    },
                    "businessImpact": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "none",
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high"
                      ],
                      "description": "The business impact if this edge case is not handled."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "scenario",
                    "conditions",
                    "testability",
                    "businessImpact"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A structured list of edge cases that might not be handled correctly."
              },
              "invalidAssumptions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the assumption."
                    },
                    "statement": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The assumption being made."
                    },
                    "validity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "valid",
                        "questionable",
                        "invalid",
                        "unknown"
                      ],
                      "description": "Assessment of the assumption's validity."
                    },
                    "dependencies": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "What this assumption depends on."
                    },
                    "consequences": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "What happens if this assumption is wrong."
                    },
                    "verification": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How this assumption could be verified or tested."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "statement",
                    "validity"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A structured list of assumptions that may be invalid or questionable."
              },
              "alternativeApproaches": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the alternative approach."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A name or title for the alternative approach."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the alternative approach."
                    },
                    "advantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "The advantages of this approach over the current one."
                    },
                    "disadvantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "The disadvantages or trade-offs of this approach."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high"
                      ],
                      "description": "The implementation complexity of this approach."
                    },
                    "feasibility": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The feasibility score (0-1) of implementing this approach.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "timeToImplement": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Estimated time to implement this approach."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "advantages",
                    "disadvantages",
                    "complexity",
                    "feasibility"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A structured list of alternative approaches or solutions."
              },
              "confidenceLevel": {
                "type": "number",
                "minimum": 0,
                "maximum": 1,
                "description": "Overall confidence (0-1) in the completeness of this analysis."
              },
              "analysisDepth": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "surface",
                  "moderate",
                  "deep",
                  "comprehensive"
                ],
                "description": "The depth level of the critical analysis performed."
              },
              "timeSpent": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Time spent on this analysis (e.g., '2 hours')."
              },
              "reviewers": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "List of people who reviewed or contributed to this analysis."
              },
              "overallAssessment": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "An overall assessment or summary of the critical analysis."
              },
              "prioritizedRecommendations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Prioritized list of recommendations based on the analysis."
              },
              "nextSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Suggested next steps for addressing the findings."
              },
              "followUpQuestions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Questions that arose during analysis and need further investigation."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "subject",
              "potentialIssues",
              "edgeCases",
              "invalidAssumptions",
              "alternativeApproaches"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__debugging_approach",
          "description": "Systematic debugging methodologies for troubleshooting and problem resolution.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "approachName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the systematic debugging method being applied (e.g., 'Log Analysis', 'Delta Debugging', 'Root Cause Analysis').",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "sessionId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Unique identifier for this debugging session."
              },
              "issue": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A detailed and specific description of the problem, including observed vs. expected behavior, and steps to reproduce if known.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "classification": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "category": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "functional",
                      "performance",
                      "security",
                      "usability",
                      "compatibility",
                      "reliability",
                      "maintainability"
                    ],
                    "description": "Primary category of the issue."
                  },
                  "severity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "critical",
                      "high",
                      "medium",
                      "low"
                    ],
                    "description": "Severity level of the issue."
                  },
                  "priority": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "urgent",
                      "high",
                      "medium",
                      "low"
                    ],
                    "description": "Priority for fixing this issue."
                  },
                  "impact": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "system-wide",
                      "module-specific",
                      "feature-specific",
                      "edge-case"
                    ],
                    "description": "Scope of impact of the issue."
                  },
                  "frequency": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "always",
                      "often",
                      "sometimes",
                      "rarely",
                      "once"
                    ],
                    "description": "How frequently the issue occurs."
                  },
                  "environment": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Environments where the issue occurs (e.g., 'production', 'staging')."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "category",
                  "severity",
                  "priority",
                  "impact",
                  "frequency"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Structured classification of the issue."
              },
              "method": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "Binary Search Debugging",
                      "The 5 Whys",
                      "Saff Squeeze",
                      "Rubber Duck Debugging",
                      "Divide & Conquer",
                      "Hypothesis Testing",
                      "Log Analysis",
                      "Static Analysis",
                      "Root Cause Analysis",
                      "Delta Debugging",
                      "Fuzzing",
                      "Incremental Testing",
                      "Bisection Method",
                      "Wolf Fence Algorithm",
                      "Tracing",
                      "Print Debugging",
                      "Interactive Debugging",
                      "Profiling",
                      "Memory Analysis",
                      "Performance Analysis",
                      "Custom"
                    ],
                    "description": "The systematic debugging method being applied."
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Detailed description of how this debugging method works."
                  },
                  "aiOptimized": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "description": "Whether this method leverages AI for enhanced problem-solving capabilities."
                  },
                  "complexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "low",
                      "medium",
                      "high",
                      "expert"
                    ],
                    "description": "Complexity level required to apply this method effectively."
                  },
                  "timeEstimate": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Estimated time to apply this method (e.g., '30 minutes', '2 hours')."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "name"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Detailed information about the debugging method being used."
              },
              "hypotheses": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Unique identifier for this hypothesis."
                    },
                    "statement": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The hypothesis statement about the potential cause."
                    },
                    "confidence": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "Confidence level (0-1) in this hypothesis.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "evidence": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "IDs of evidence supporting this hypothesis."
                    },
                    "testPlan": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Plan for testing this hypothesis."
                    },
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "proposed",
                        "testing",
                        "confirmed",
                        "refuted",
                        "inconclusive"
                      ],
                      "description": "Current status of the hypothesis."
                    },
                    "priority": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high",
                        "critical"
                      ],
                      "description": "Priority for testing this hypothesis."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "statement",
                    "confidence",
                    "status"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Hypotheses about potential causes of the issue."
              },
              "evidence": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Unique identifier for this piece of evidence."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "log",
                        "error_message",
                        "stack_trace",
                        "performance_metric",
                        "user_report",
                        "test_result",
                        "code_analysis",
                        "observation"
                      ],
                      "description": "Type of evidence collected."
                    },
                    "source": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Where this evidence was collected from."
                    },
                    "content": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The actual evidence content or description."
                    },
                    "timestamp": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "When this evidence was collected."
                    },
                    "relevance": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "high",
                        "medium",
                        "low"
                      ],
                      "description": "Relevance of this evidence to the issue."
                    },
                    "verified": {
                      "type": "boolean",
                      "description": "Whether this evidence has been verified or confirmed."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "type",
                    "source",
                    "content"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Evidence collected during the debugging process."
              },
              "steps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Debugging steps taken, either as simple strings or detailed step objects."
              },
              "findings": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The key observations, data points, or discoveries made during the debugging process."
              },
              "aiAnalysis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "patternRecognition": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                      "similarIssues": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "description": "Similar issues identified by AI analysis."
                      },
                      "patterns": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "description": "Patterns identified in logs, code, or behavior."
                      },
                      "anomalies": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "description": "Anomalies detected by AI analysis."
                      }
                    },
                    "required": [],
                    "additionalProperties": false,
                    "description": "AI-powered pattern recognition results."
                  },
                  "recommendations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "action": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Recommended action."
                        },
                        "confidence": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "description": "AI confidence in this recommendation.",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 1
                        },
                        "reasoning": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "AI reasoning behind this recommendation."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "action",
                        "confidence",
                        "reasoning"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "AI-generated recommendations."
                  },
                  "riskAssessment": {
                    "type": "object",
                    "properties": {
                      "riskLevel": {
                        "type": "string",
                        "enum": [
                          "low",
                          "medium",
                          "high",
                          "critical"
                        ],
                        "description": "Overall risk level."
                      },
                      "factors": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "description": "Risk factors identified."
                      },
                      "mitigation": {
                        "type": "array",
                        "items": {
                          "type": "string"
                        },
                        "description": "Risk mitigation strategies."
                      }
                    },
                    "required": [
                      "riskLevel",
                      "factors"
                    ],
                    "additionalProperties": false,
                    "description": "AI risk assessment of the issue and proposed solutions."
                  }
                },
                "required": [],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "AI-powered analysis results for enhanced debugging capabilities."
              },
              "resolution": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear explanation of the final fix, including any code changes, configuration updates, or other actions taken."
              },
              "preventionMeasures": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Measures to prevent similar issues in the future."
              },
              "lessonsLearned": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Key lessons learned from this debugging session."
              },
              "startTime": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "When the debugging session started."
              },
              "endTime": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "When the debugging session ended."
              },
              "totalDuration": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Total time spent debugging."
              },
              "participants": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "People involved in the debugging process."
              },
              "tools": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Tools and technologies used during debugging."
              },
              "effectiveness": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "timeToResolution": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Time taken to resolve the issue."
                  },
                  "accuracyOfInitialHypothesis": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1,
                    "description": "How accurate the initial hypothesis was (0-1)."
                  },
                  "methodEffectiveness": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "very-effective",
                      "effective",
                      "somewhat-effective",
                      "ineffective"
                    ],
                    "description": "Effectiveness of the chosen debugging method."
                  },
                  "satisfactionScore": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 1,
                    "maximum": 5,
                    "description": "Satisfaction score with the debugging process (1-5)."
                  }
                },
                "required": [],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Metrics for evaluating the effectiveness of the debugging approach."
              },
              "documentation": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "publicSummary": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Public summary suitable for sharing with the team."
                  },
                  "technicalDetails": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Technical details for future reference."
                  },
                  "codeChanges": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "List of code changes made."
                  },
                  "configChanges": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "List of configuration changes made."
                  }
                },
                "required": [],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Documentation of the debugging process and resolution."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "approachName",
              "issue"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__decision_framework",
          "description": "Structured decision analysis and rational choice frameworks for complex decisions.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "decisionStatement": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and concise statement of the decision to be made."
              },
              "options": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the decision option."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the decision option."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the decision option."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of the options being considered."
              },
              "criteria": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "weight": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The weight of the criterion in the decision (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "evaluationMethod": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "quantitative",
                        "qualitative",
                        "boolean"
                      ],
                      "description": "The method used to evaluate the criterion."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "weight",
                    "evaluationMethod"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of the criteria used to evaluate the options."
              },
              "stakeholders": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of stakeholders involved in the decision."
              },
              "constraints": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of constraints on the decision."
              },
              "timeHorizon": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The time horizon for the decision."
              },
              "riskTolerance": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "risk-averse",
                  "risk-neutral",
                  "risk-seeking"
                ],
                "description": "The risk tolerance for the decision."
              },
              "possibleOutcomes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the possible outcome."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the possible outcome."
                    },
                    "probability": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The probability of this outcome occurring (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "value": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The value of this outcome."
                    },
                    "optionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the option this outcome is associated with."
                    },
                    "confidenceInEstimate": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the probability and value estimates.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "probability",
                    "value",
                    "optionId",
                    "confidenceInEstimate"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of possible outcomes for the decision."
              },
              "criteriaEvaluations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "criterionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the criterion being evaluated."
                    },
                    "optionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the option being evaluated against the criterion."
                    },
                    "score": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The score of the option against the criterion (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "justification": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The justification for the score."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "criterionId",
                    "optionId",
                    "score",
                    "justification"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of evaluations of the options against the criteria."
              },
              "informationGaps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A description of the information gap."
                    },
                    "impact": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The potential impact of this information gap on the decision (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "researchMethod": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The method for researching and filling this information gap."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "impact",
                    "researchMethod"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of information gaps that need to be filled."
              },
              "analysisType": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "expected-utility",
                  "multi-criteria",
                  "maximin",
                  "minimax-regret",
                  "satisficing"
                ],
                "description": "The type of analysis to be performed."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "problem-definition",
                  "options",
                  "criteria",
                  "evaluation",
                  "analysis",
                  "recommendation"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the decision-making process."
              },
              "recommendation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final recommendation."
              },
              "sensitivityInsights": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of insights from sensitivity analysis."
              },
              "expectedValues": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "number"
                },
                "description": "A record of the expected values for each option."
              },
              "multiCriteriaScores": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "number"
                },
                "description": "A record of the multi-criteria scores for each option."
              },
              "decisionId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this decision."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this decision-making process."
              },
              "suggestedNextStage": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The suggested next stage in the decision-making process."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another stage is needed."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "decisionStatement",
              "options",
              "analysisType",
              "stage",
              "decisionId",
              "iteration",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__domain_modeling",
          "description": "Creating and refining conceptual models of a domain, including entities, relationships, and rules.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "domainName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the domain being modeled."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A detailed description of the domain."
              },
              "modelingId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this modeling session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this modeling session."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "analysis",
                  "conceptual",
                  "logical",
                  "physical",
                  "validation",
                  "refinement"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the modeling process."
              },
              "entities": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the entity."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the entity."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the entity's purpose and role."
                    },
                    "attributes": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of data attributes associated with the entity."
                    },
                    "behaviors": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of behaviors or operations the entity can perform."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of rules or constraints that apply to this entity."
                    },
                    "invariants": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of conditions that must always be true for this entity."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "attributes"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all entities in the domain."
              },
              "relationships": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the relationship."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the relationship."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "one-to-one",
                        "one-to-many",
                        "many-to-many",
                        "inheritance",
                        "composition",
                        "aggregation",
                        "dependency"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of relationship between entities."
                    },
                    "sourceEntity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the source entity in the relationship."
                    },
                    "targetEntity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the target entity in the relationship."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the relationship."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of rules or constraints that apply to this relationship."
                    },
                    "cardinality": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The cardinality of the relationship (e.g., '1..*')."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "type",
                    "sourceEntity",
                    "targetEntity",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all relationships between entities."
              },
              "domainRules": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the domain rule."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "business-rule",
                        "validation-rule",
                        "constraint",
                        "invariant",
                        "axiom"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "entities": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of entities to which this rule applies."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that must be met for the rule to apply."
                    },
                    "consequence": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The consequence of the rule being met."
                    },
                    "priority": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high",
                        "critical"
                      ],
                      "description": "The priority of the domain rule."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "type",
                    "entities",
                    "condition"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all domain rules."
              },
              "boundaries": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The name of the bounded context."
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A description of the bounded context."
                  },
                  "includedEntities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of entities included in this bounded context."
                  },
                  "excludedConcepts": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of concepts explicitly excluded from this bounded context."
                  },
                  "interfaces": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of interfaces this bounded context exposes."
                  },
                  "responsibilities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of responsibilities of this bounded context."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "name",
                  "description",
                  "includedEntities"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The bounded context of the domain."
              },
              "assumptions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of assumptions made during the modeling process."
              },
              "stakeholders": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of stakeholders involved in the modeling process."
              },
              "useCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of use cases for the domain."
              },
              "modelValidation": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "completeness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the completeness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "consistency": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the consistency of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "correctness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the correctness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "issues": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of identified issues with the model."
                  },
                  "suggestions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of suggestions for improving the model."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "completeness",
                  "consistency",
                  "correctness"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Validation results for the model."
              },
              "abstractionLevel": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "high",
                  "medium",
                  "low"
                ],
                "description": "The level of abstraction of the model."
              },
              "paradigm": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "object-oriented",
                  "relational",
                  "functional",
                  "event-driven",
                  "service-oriented",
                  "domain-driven"
                ],
                "description": "The modeling paradigm used."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another modeling stage is required."
              },
              "suggestedNextStage": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The suggested next stage in the modeling process."
              },
              "modelingNotes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of notes related to the modeling process."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "domainName",
              "description",
              "modelingId",
              "iteration",
              "stage",
              "entities",
              "abstractionLevel",
              "paradigm",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__mental_model",
          "description": "Tool for creating and analyzing mental models to understand complex problems and systems.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "modelName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the mental model being used (e.g., 'Second-Order Thinking', 'First Principles'). This helps categorize the analysis.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear, specific, and bounded description of the problem being analyzed. A good problem statement is crucial for effective model application. For example, 'How can we reduce user friction in our onboarding flow?' is better than 'Make the app better'.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "steps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A sequential, logical breakdown of how the mental model is applied. Each step should be a clear action or point of analysis, demonstrating the model's framework."
              },
              "reasoning": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The core logic behind the analysis. Explain *why* this model is appropriate for this problem and *how* the steps connect to the model's principles. This is crucial for evaluating the application's quality."
              },
              "conclusion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final, actionable insight or decision. It should be a direct synthesis of the preceding steps and reasoning."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "modelName",
              "problem"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__metacognitive_monitoring",
          "description": "Self-assessment of knowledge and reasoning quality for improved metacognition.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "task": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The overall task or problem being addressed."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "knowledge-assessment",
                  "planning",
                  "execution",
                  "monitoring",
                  "evaluation",
                  "reflection"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the metacognitive process."
              },
              "knowledgeAssessment": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "domain": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific domain or topic being assessed."
                  },
                  "knowledgeLevel": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "expert",
                      "proficient",
                      "familiar",
                      "basic",
                      "minimal",
                      "none"
                    ],
                    "description": "The self-assessed level of knowledge in this domain."
                  },
                  "confidenceScore": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed knowledge level.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "supportingEvidence": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Evidence to support the assessed knowledge level."
                  },
                  "knownLimitations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of known limitations or gaps in knowledge."
                  },
                  "relevantTrainingCutoff": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The date of the last relevant training or data cutoff."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "domain",
                  "knowledgeLevel",
                  "confidenceScore",
                  "supportingEvidence",
                  "knownLimitations"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "An assessment of the knowledge required for the task."
              },
              "claims": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "claim": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific claim being assessed."
                    },
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "fact",
                        "inference",
                        "speculation",
                        "uncertain"
                      ],
                      "description": "The assessed status of the claim."
                    },
                    "confidenceScore": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed status of the claim.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "evidenceBasis": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The evidence supporting the assessment of the claim."
                    },
                    "falsifiabilityCriteria": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Criteria that could be used to falsify the claim."
                    },
                    "alternativeInterpretations": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of alternative interpretations of the evidence."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "claim",
                    "status",
                    "confidenceScore",
                    "evidenceBasis"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of claims being made and assessed."
              },
              "reasoningSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "step": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific step in the reasoning process being assessed."
                    },
                    "potentialBiases": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of potential cognitive biases that may be influencing the reasoning."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of assumptions being made in this reasoning step."
                    },
                    "logicalValidity": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the logical validity of the reasoning step.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "inferenceStrength": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the strength of the inference.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "step",
                    "potentialBiases",
                    "assumptions",
                    "logicalValidity",
                    "inferenceStrength"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of reasoning steps being assessed."
              },
              "overallConfidence": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "An overall confidence score (0-1) in the ability to complete the task successfully.",
                "minimum": 0,
                "maximum": 1
              },
              "uncertaintyAreas": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of areas where there is significant uncertainty."
              },
              "recommendedApproach": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The recommended approach to address the task, given the metacognitive assessment."
              },
              "monitoringId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this monitoring session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this monitoring session."
              },
              "suggestedAssessments": {
                "type": "array",
