                    "claim",
                    "reasoning",
                    "overall"
                  ]
                },
                "description": "A list of suggested next assessments."
              },
              "previousSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A record of the steps that have already been completed."
              },
              "remainingSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A high-level list of the steps that are yet to be taken."
              },
              "toolUsageHistory": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "toolName": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the tool that was used."
                    },
                    "usedAt": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The timestamp at which the tool was used."
                    },
                    "effectivenessScore": {
                      "type": "number",

                    }
                  },
                  "required": [

                    "usedAt"

                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A log of the tools that have been used so far, along with their effectiveness."
              },
              "nextAssessmentNeeded": {

              }

            "required": [

              "recommendedApproach",
              "monitoringId",
              "iteration",
              "nextAssessmentNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__problem_decomposition",
          "description": "Breaking down complex problems into manageable sub-problems and tasks.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "problem": {

                      "type": "string",

                        "low",

                        "high"

                      "description": "Complexity level of this task."
                    },
                    "category": {
                      "type": "string",

                    },
                    "tags": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },

                    },
                    "resourceRequirements": {
                      "type": "array",

                        "type": "object",

                          "type": {

                              "human",
                              "financial",
                              "technical",
                              "infrastructure",
                              "external"

                            "description": "The type of resource required."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of the specific resource needed."
                          },
                          "quantity": {
                            "type": "string",

                          },
                          "availability": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "available",
                              "limited",
                              "unavailable",
                              "unknown"
                            ],
                            "description": "Current availability of this resource."

                          "criticality": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high",
                              "critical"

                            "description": "How critical this resource is for task completion."

                        },
                        "required": [
                          "type",

                      "description": "Resources required to complete this task."

                    "risks": {
                      "type": "array",

                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",

                            "type": "string",

                              "high",

                            ],

                            "type": "string",

                            "description": "Contingency plan if the risk occurs."

                        },
                        "required": [
                          "description",
                          "probability",
                          "impact",
                          "category"

                        "additionalProperties": false

                      "description": "Potential risks associated with this task."

                    "stakeholders": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "name": {
                            "type": "string",

                          "role": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "owner",
                              "contributor",
                              "reviewer",
                              "approver",
                              "informed"

                            "description": "The stakeholder's role in this task."

                          "influence": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of influence this stakeholder has."
                          },
                          "interest": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of interest this stakeholder has."
                          },
                          "availability": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Availability of this stakeholder."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "name",
                          "role",
                          "influence",
                          "interest"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Stakeholders involved in or affected by this task."
                    },
                    "acceptanceCriteria": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "A unique identifier for the acceptance criterion."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of what must be achieved for the task to be considered complete."
                          },
                          "measurable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "description": "Whether this criterion can be objectively measured."
                          },
                          "priority": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "must-have",
                              "should-have",
                              "could-have",
                              "won't-have"
                            ],
                            "description": "Priority level of this criterion."
                          },
                          "testable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "description": "Whether this criterion can be tested or verified."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "description",
                          "measurable",
                          "priority",
                          "testable"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Criteria that must be met for the task to be considered complete."
                    },
                    "progress": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "status": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "not-started",
                            "in-progress",
                            "blocked",
                            "completed",
                            "cancelled"
                          ],
                          "description": "Current status of the task."
                        },
                        "percentComplete": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 100,
                          "description": "Percentage completion (0-100)."
                        },
                        "startDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned start date."
                        },
                        "endDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned end date."
                        },
                        "lastUpdated": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "When the progress was last updated."
                        },
                        "blockers": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "Current blockers preventing progress."
                        },
                        "milestones": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "object",
                            "properties": {
                              "name": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Name of the milestone."
                              },
                              "date": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Target or actual date of the milestone."
                              },
                              "achieved": {
                                "type": "boolean",
                                "description": "Whether the milestone has been achieved."
                              }
                            },
                            "required": [
                              "name",
                              "date",
                              "achieved"
                            ],
                            "additionalProperties": false
                          },
                          "description": "Key milestones for this task."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "status"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Current progress and status of the task."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Assumptions made about this task."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Constraints that limit how this task can be completed."

                    "deliverables": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Specific deliverables expected from this task."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [

                },

              "metrics": {

                      "high": {
                        "type": "number",

                      }
                    },
                    "required": [

                      "high"

              },

                "type": "string",

              }

            "required": [

              "decomposition"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__recursive_thinking",
          "description": "Applying recursive strategies to solve problems with base and recursive cases, including optimizations.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and comprehensive description of the problem to be solved recursively."
              },
              "problemId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this recursive problem analysis."
              },
              "domain": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The domain or field this problem belongs to (e.g., 'algorithms', 'data structures')."
              },
              "baseCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the base case."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that defines when this base case applies."
                    },
                    "solution": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The direct solution for this base case."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Time/space complexity of solving this base case."
                    },
                    "examples": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Concrete examples of inputs that trigger this base case."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "condition",
                    "solution"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The base cases that terminate the recursion."
              },
              "recursiveCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the recursive case."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that defines when this recursive case applies."
                    },
                    "decomposition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the problem is broken down into smaller subproblems."
                    },
                    "recombination": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the solutions to subproblems are combined."
                    },
                    "reductionFactor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How much the problem size is reduced in each recursive call."
                    },
                    "examples": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Concrete examples of inputs that trigger this recursive case."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "condition",
                    "decomposition",
                    "recombination"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The recursive cases that break down the problem."
              },
              "terminationConditions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "All conditions under which the recursion will terminate."
              },
              "complexityAnalysis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "timeComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The time complexity of the recursive solution (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(2^n)')."
                  },
                  "spaceComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                  },
                  "maxStackDepth": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                  },
                  "worstCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                  },
                  "bestCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "timeComplexity",
                  "spaceComplexity"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Detailed complexity analysis of the recursive solution."
              },
              "optimizations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "technique": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The optimization technique (e.g., 'memoization', 'tail recursion')."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Description of how the optimization works."
                    },
                    "complexityImprovement": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the optimization improves complexity."
                    },
                    "tradeoffs": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Trade-offs introduced by this optimization."
                    },
                    "implementation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Implementation details or pseudocode for the optimization."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "technique",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Possible optimizations for the recursive solution."
              },
              "iterativeAlternatives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "approach": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The iterative approach (e.g., 'bottom-up dynamic programming', 'stack-based iteration')."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Detailed description of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "advantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Advantages of the iterative approach over recursion."
                    },
                    "disadvantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Disadvantages of the iterative approach."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "timeComplexity": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The time complexity of the recursive solution (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(2^n)')."
                        },
                        "spaceComplexity": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                        },
                        "maxStackDepth": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                        },
                        "worstCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                        },
                        "bestCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "timeComplexity",
                        "spaceComplexity"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Complexity analysis of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "implementation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Pseudocode or implementation details."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "approach",
                    "description",
                    "advantages",
                    "disadvantages"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Alternative iterative solutions."
              },
              "stackOverflowRisk": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "low",
                  "medium",
                  "high"
                ],
                "description": "Risk of stack overflow for typical inputs."
              },
              "inputSizeLimit": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Practical limit on input size before stack overflow."
              },
              "tailRecursionOptimizable": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Whether the recursion can be optimized with tail recursion."
              },
              "invariants": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Properties that remain true throughout the recursive calls."
              },
              "testCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "input": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Description of the test input."
                    },
                    "expectedOutput": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Expected output for this input."
                    },
                    "reasoning": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Why this test case is important."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "input",
                    "expectedOutput"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Key test cases for validating the recursive solution."
              },
              "recursionPattern": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "linear",
                  "binary",
                  "tree",
                  "mutual",
                  "indirect",
                  "nested"
                ],
                "description": "The pattern of recursion used."
              },
              "similarProblems": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Other problems that use similar recursive patterns."
              },
              "learningObjectives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "What can be learned from this recursive analysis."
              },
              "commonMistakes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Common mistakes when implementing this recursive solution."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "problem",
              "baseCases",
              "recursiveCases",
              "terminationConditions"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__scientific_method",
          "description": "Formal hypothesis testing and experimentation following the scientific method.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "observation",
                  "question",
                  "hypothesis",
                  "experiment",
                  "analysis",
                  "conclusion",
                  "iteration"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage in the scientific inquiry process."
              },
              "observation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "An initial observation that sparks inquiry (e.g., 'The new feature has lower engagement than expected')."
              },
              "question": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A specific question that arises from the observation (e.g., 'Why is user engagement low?')."
              },
              "hypothesis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "statement": {

                      "type": "object",

                        "name": {

                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "independent",
                            "dependent",
                            "controlled",
                            "confounding"
                          ],
                          "description": "The role of the variable in the experiment. Independent: the one you change. Dependent: the one you measure. Controlled: the ones you keep constant."
                        },
                        "operationalization": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "A precise description of how the variable will be measured or manipulated (e.g., 'Latency measured as Time to First Byte in ms', 'Conversion measured by sign-ups per 1000 visitors')."

                      },
                      "required": [
                        "name",
                        "type"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },

                  "assumptions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"

                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for tracking this specific hypothesis."

                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A prior confidence score (0-1) in the hypothesis before testing.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "domain": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific area of study or context of the hypothesis (e.g., 'UI/UX Optimization')."
                  },
                  "iteration": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "The version number of this hypothesis, for tracking refinements."
                  },
                  "alternativeTo": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of IDs of competing or alternative hypotheses."

                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of a previous, broader hypothesis that this one refines."

                  "status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "proposed",
                      "testing",
                      "supported",
                      "refuted",
                      "refined"

                "required": [

                  "assumptions",

                  "domain",
                  "iteration",

                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The formal hypothesis being investigated."

              "experiment": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "design": {
                    "type": "string",

                  },
                  "methodology": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The step-by-step procedure for conducting the experiment."
                  },
                  "predictions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "if": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific condition or action to be taken in the experiment (e.g., 'If we decrease the button size by 50%')."
                        },
                        "then": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific, measurable outcome expected if the hypothesis is true (e.g., 'then the user conversion rate will drop by at least 5%')."
                        },
                        "else": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "An alternative outcome, which might support a competing hypothesis (e.g., 'else the conversion rate will remain unchanged')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [

                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "The specific, testable predictions derived from the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "experimentId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for this specific experiment."
                  },
                  "hypothesisId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of the hypothesis this experiment is designed to test."
                  },
                  "controlMeasures": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Measures taken to prevent confounding variables from influencing the results (e.g., 'Ensuring both user groups have similar demographics')."
                  },
                  "results": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A summary of the raw data or findings from the experiment."
                  },
                  "outcomeMatched": {
                    "type": "boolean",

                  "predictions",
                  "experimentId",

Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with \"only core types\" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.",

              },
              "rrule": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: \"DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1\""
              },

              },
              "tools": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Tools and technologies used during debugging."
              },
              "effectiveness": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "timeToResolution": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Time taken to resolve the issue."
                  },
                  "accuracyOfInitialHypothesis": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1,
                    "description": "How accurate the initial hypothesis was (0-1)."
                  },
                  "methodEffectiveness": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "very-effective",
                      "effective",
                      "somewhat-effective",
                      "ineffective"
                    ],
                    "description": "Effectiveness of the chosen debugging method."
                  },
                  "satisfactionScore": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "minimum": 1,
                    "maximum": 5,
                    "description": "Satisfaction score with the debugging process (1-5)."
                  }
                },
                "required": [],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Metrics for evaluating the effectiveness of the debugging approach."
              },
              "documentation": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "publicSummary": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Public summary suitable for sharing with the team."
                  },
                  "technicalDetails": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Technical details for future reference."
                  },
                  "codeChanges": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "List of code changes made."
                  },
                  "configChanges": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "List of configuration changes made."
                  }
                },
                "required": [],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Documentation of the debugging process and resolution."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "approachName",
              "issue"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__decision_framework",
          "description": "Structured decision analysis and rational choice frameworks for complex decisions.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "decisionStatement": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and concise statement of the decision to be made."
              },
              "options": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the decision option."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the decision option."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the decision option."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of the options being considered."
              },
              "criteria": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the decision criterion."
                    },
                    "weight": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The weight of the criterion in the decision (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "evaluationMethod": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "quantitative",
                        "qualitative",
                        "boolean"
                      ],
                      "description": "The method used to evaluate the criterion."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "weight",
                    "evaluationMethod"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of the criteria used to evaluate the options."
              },
              "stakeholders": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of stakeholders involved in the decision."
              },
              "constraints": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of constraints on the decision."
              },
              "timeHorizon": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The time horizon for the decision."
              },
              "riskTolerance": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "risk-averse",
                  "risk-neutral",
                  "risk-seeking"
                ],
                "description": "The risk tolerance for the decision."
              },
              "possibleOutcomes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the possible outcome."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the possible outcome."
                    },
                    "probability": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The probability of this outcome occurring (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "value": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The value of this outcome."
                    },
                    "optionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the option this outcome is associated with."
                    },
                    "confidenceInEstimate": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the probability and value estimates.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "probability",
                    "value",
                    "optionId",
                    "confidenceInEstimate"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of possible outcomes for the decision."
              },
              "criteriaEvaluations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "criterionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the criterion being evaluated."
                    },
                    "optionId": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The ID of the option being evaluated against the criterion."
                    },
                    "score": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The score of the option against the criterion (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "justification": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The justification for the score."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "criterionId",
                    "optionId",
                    "score",
                    "justification"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of evaluations of the options against the criteria."
              },
              "informationGaps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A description of the information gap."
                    },
                    "impact": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "The potential impact of this information gap on the decision (0-1).",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "researchMethod": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The method for researching and filling this information gap."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "description",
                    "impact",
                    "researchMethod"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of information gaps that need to be filled."
              },
              "analysisType": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "expected-utility",
                  "multi-criteria",
                  "maximin",
                  "minimax-regret",
                  "satisficing"
                ],
                "description": "The type of analysis to be performed."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "problem-definition",
                  "options",
                  "criteria",
                  "evaluation",
                  "analysis",
                  "recommendation"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the decision-making process."
              },
              "recommendation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final recommendation."
              },
              "sensitivityInsights": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of insights from sensitivity analysis."
              },
              "expectedValues": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "number"
                },
                "description": "A record of the expected values for each option."
              },
              "multiCriteriaScores": {
                "type": "object",
                "additionalProperties": {
                  "type": "number"
                },
                "description": "A record of the multi-criteria scores for each option."
              },
              "decisionId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this decision."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this decision-making process."
              },
              "suggestedNextStage": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The suggested next stage in the decision-making process."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another stage is needed."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "decisionStatement",
              "options",
              "analysisType",
              "stage",
              "decisionId",
              "iteration",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__domain_modeling",
          "description": "Creating and refining conceptual models of a domain, including entities, relationships, and rules.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "domainName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the domain being modeled."
              },
              "description": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A detailed description of the domain."
              },
              "modelingId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this modeling session."
              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "The iteration number of this modeling session."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "analysis",
                  "conceptual",
                  "logical",
                  "physical",
                  "validation",
                  "refinement"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the modeling process."
              },
              "entities": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the entity."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the entity."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the entity's purpose and role."
                    },
                    "attributes": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of data attributes associated with the entity."
                    },
                    "behaviors": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of behaviors or operations the entity can perform."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of rules or constraints that apply to this entity."
                    },
                    "invariants": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of conditions that must always be true for this entity."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "attributes"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all entities in the domain."
              },
              "relationships": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the relationship."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the relationship."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "one-to-one",
                        "one-to-many",
                        "many-to-many",
                        "inheritance",
                        "composition",
                        "aggregation",
                        "dependency"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of relationship between entities."
                    },
                    "sourceEntity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the source entity in the relationship."
                    },
                    "targetEntity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the target entity in the relationship."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the relationship."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of rules or constraints that apply to this relationship."
                    },
                    "cardinality": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The cardinality of the relationship (e.g., '1..*')."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "type",
                    "sourceEntity",
                    "targetEntity",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all relationships between entities."
              },
              "domainRules": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the domain rule."
                    },
                    "name": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A detailed description of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "type": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "business-rule",
                        "validation-rule",
                        "constraint",
                        "invariant",
                        "axiom"
                      ],
                      "description": "The type of the domain rule."
                    },
                    "entities": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of entities to which this rule applies."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that must be met for the rule to apply."
                    },
                    "consequence": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The consequence of the rule being met."
                    },
                    "priority": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "low",
                        "medium",
                        "high",
                        "critical"
                      ],
                      "description": "The priority of the domain rule."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "name",
                    "description",
                    "type",
                    "entities",
                    "condition"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of all domain rules."
              },
              "boundaries": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "name": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The name of the bounded context."
                  },
                  "description": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A description of the bounded context."
                  },
                  "includedEntities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of entities included in this bounded context."
                  },
                  "excludedConcepts": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of concepts explicitly excluded from this bounded context."
                  },
                  "interfaces": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of interfaces this bounded context exposes."
                  },
                  "responsibilities": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of responsibilities of this bounded context."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "name",
                  "description",
                  "includedEntities"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "The bounded context of the domain."
              },
              "assumptions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of assumptions made during the modeling process."
              },
              "stakeholders": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of stakeholders involved in the modeling process."
              },
              "useCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of use cases for the domain."
              },
              "modelValidation": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "completeness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the completeness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "consistency": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the consistency of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "correctness": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A score indicating the correctness of the model.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "issues": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of identified issues with the model."
                  },
                  "suggestions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of suggestions for improving the model."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "completeness",
                  "consistency",
                  "correctness"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Validation results for the model."
              },
              "abstractionLevel": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "high",
                  "medium",
                  "low"
                ],
                "description": "The level of abstraction of the model."
              },
              "paradigm": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "object-oriented",
                  "relational",
                  "functional",
                  "event-driven",
                  "service-oriented",
                  "domain-driven"
                ],
                "description": "The modeling paradigm used."
              },
              "nextStageNeeded": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "A flag indicating whether another modeling stage is required."
              },
              "suggestedNextStage": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The suggested next stage in the modeling process."
              },
              "modelingNotes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of notes related to the modeling process."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "domainName",
              "description",
              "modelingId",
              "iteration",
              "stage",
              "entities",
              "abstractionLevel",
              "paradigm",
              "nextStageNeeded"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__mental_model",
          "description": "Tool for creating and analyzing mental models to understand complex problems and systems.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "modelName": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The name of the mental model being used (e.g., 'Second-Order Thinking', 'First Principles'). This helps categorize the analysis.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear, specific, and bounded description of the problem being analyzed. A good problem statement is crucial for effective model application. For example, 'How can we reduce user friction in our onboarding flow?' is better than 'Make the app better'.",
                "minLength": 1
              },
              "steps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A sequential, logical breakdown of how the mental model is applied. Each step should be a clear action or point of analysis, demonstrating the model's framework."
              },
              "reasoning": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The core logic behind the analysis. Explain *why* this model is appropriate for this problem and *how* the steps connect to the model's principles. This is crucial for evaluating the application's quality."
              },
              "conclusion": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The final, actionable insight or decision. It should be a direct synthesis of the preceding steps and reasoning."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "modelName",
              "problem"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__metacognitive_monitoring",
          "description": "Self-assessment of knowledge and reasoning quality for improved metacognition.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "task": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The overall task or problem being addressed."
              },
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "knowledge-assessment",
                  "planning",
                  "execution",
                  "monitoring",
                  "evaluation",
                  "reflection"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage of the metacognitive process."
              },
              "knowledgeAssessment": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "domain": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific domain or topic being assessed."
                  },
                  "knowledgeLevel": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [
                      "expert",
                      "proficient",
                      "familiar",
                      "basic",
                      "minimal",
                      "none"
                    ],
                    "description": "The self-assessed level of knowledge in this domain."
                  },
                  "confidenceScore": {
                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed knowledge level.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },
                  "supportingEvidence": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Evidence to support the assessed knowledge level."
                  },
                  "knownLimitations": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of known limitations or gaps in knowledge."
                  },
                  "relevantTrainingCutoff": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The date of the last relevant training or data cutoff."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "domain",
                  "knowledgeLevel",
                  "confidenceScore",
                  "supportingEvidence",
                  "knownLimitations"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "An assessment of the knowledge required for the task."
              },
              "claims": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "claim": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific claim being assessed."
                    },
                    "status": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "enum": [
                        "fact",
                        "inference",
                        "speculation",
                        "uncertain"
                      ],
                      "description": "The assessed status of the claim."
                    },
                    "confidenceScore": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A confidence score (0-1) in the assessed status of the claim.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "evidenceBasis": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The evidence supporting the assessment of the claim."
                    },
                    "falsifiabilityCriteria": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Criteria that could be used to falsify the claim."
                    },
                    "alternativeInterpretations": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of alternative interpretations of the evidence."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "claim",
                    "status",
                    "confidenceScore",
                    "evidenceBasis"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of claims being made and assessed."
              },
              "reasoningSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "step": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The specific step in the reasoning process being assessed."
                    },
                    "potentialBiases": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of potential cognitive biases that may be influencing the reasoning."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "A list of assumptions being made in this reasoning step."
                    },
                    "logicalValidity": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the logical validity of the reasoning step.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    },
                    "inferenceStrength": {
                      "type": "number",
                      "description": "A score (0-1) for the strength of the inference.",
                      "minimum": 0,
                      "maximum": 1
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "step",
                    "potentialBiases",
                    "assumptions",
                    "logicalValidity",
                    "inferenceStrength"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "A list of reasoning steps being assessed."
              },
              "overallConfidence": {
                "type": "number",
                "description": "An overall confidence score (0-1) in the ability to complete the task successfully.",
                "minimum": 0,
                "maximum": 1
              },
              "uncertaintyAreas": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A list of areas where there is significant uncertainty."
              },
              "recommendedApproach": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The recommended approach to address the task, given the metacognitive assessment."
              },
              "monitoringId": {
                "type": "string",

              },
              "iteration": {
                "type": "number",

              "suggestedAssessments": {

                    "reasoning",

                },
                "description": "A list of suggested next assessments."
              },
              "previousSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A record of the steps that have already been completed."
              },
              "remainingSteps": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "A high-level list of the steps that are yet to be taken."
              },
              "toolUsageHistory": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "toolName": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The name of the tool that was used."
                    },
                    "usedAt": {
                      "type": "string",

                  },
                  "required": [

                },
                "description": "A log of the tools that have been used so far, along with their effectiveness."
              },

            "required": [

              "recommendedApproach",
              "monitoringId",
              "iteration",
              "nextAssessmentNeeded"

            "additionalProperties": false

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__problem_decomposition",
          "description": "Breaking down complex problems into manageable sub-problems and tasks.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "problem": {

                        "medium",

                    "category": {
                      "type": "string",

                    },
                    "tags": {
                      "type": "array",

                        "type": "string"
                      },

                    },
                    "resourceRequirements": {
                      "type": "array",

                              "technical",
                              "infrastructure",
                              "external"

                            "description": "The type of resource required."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of the specific resource needed."
                          },
                          "quantity": {
                            "type": "string",

                          "availability": {
                            "type": "string",

                              "available",
                              "limited",
                              "unavailable",
                              "unknown"

                          "criticality": {
                            "type": "string",

                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high",
                              "critical"

                      "type": "array",

                            "type": "string",

                        },
                        "required": [
                          "description",
                          "probability",

                        "additionalProperties": false

                    "stakeholders": {
                      "type": "array",
