                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "name": {

                          "role": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "owner",
                              "contributor",
                              "reviewer",
                              "approver",

                          "influence": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of influence this stakeholder has."

                          "interest": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "low",
                              "medium",
                              "high"
                            ],
                            "description": "Level of interest this stakeholder has."
                          },
                          "availability": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Availability of this stakeholder."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "name",
                          "role",
                          "influence",
                          "interest"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Stakeholders involved in or affected by this task."
                    },
                    "acceptanceCriteria": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "object",
                        "properties": {
                          "id": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "A unique identifier for the acceptance criterion."
                          },
                          "description": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "description": "Description of what must be achieved for the task to be considered complete."
                          },
                          "measurable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "description": "Whether this criterion can be objectively measured."
                          },
                          "priority": {
                            "type": "string",
                            "enum": [
                              "must-have",
                              "should-have",
                              "could-have",
                              "won't-have"
                            ],
                            "description": "Priority level of this criterion."
                          },
                          "testable": {
                            "type": "boolean",
                            "description": "Whether this criterion can be tested or verified."
                          }
                        },
                        "required": [
                          "description",
                          "measurable",
                          "priority",
                          "testable"
                        ],
                        "additionalProperties": false
                      },
                      "description": "Criteria that must be met for the task to be considered complete."
                    },
                    "progress": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "status": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "not-started",
                            "in-progress",
                            "blocked",
                            "completed",
                            "cancelled"
                          ],
                          "description": "Current status of the task."
                        },
                        "percentComplete": {
                          "type": "number",
                          "minimum": 0,
                          "maximum": 100,
                          "description": "Percentage completion (0-100)."
                        },
                        "startDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned start date."
                        },
                        "endDate": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Actual or planned end date."
                        },
                        "lastUpdated": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "When the progress was last updated."
                        },
                        "blockers": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "string"
                          },
                          "description": "Current blockers preventing progress."
                        },
                        "milestones": {
                          "type": "array",
                          "items": {
                            "type": "object",

                              "name": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Name of the milestone."
                              },
                              "date": {
                                "type": "string",
                                "description": "Target or actual date of the milestone."
                              },
                              "achieved": {
                                "type": "boolean",
                                "description": "Whether the milestone has been achieved."
                              }
                            },
                            "required": [
                              "name",
                              "date",
                              "achieved"
                            ],
                            "additionalProperties": false
                          },
                          "description": "Key milestones for this task."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "status"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Current progress and status of the task."
                    },
                    "assumptions": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Assumptions made about this task."
                    },
                    "constraints": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Constraints that limit how this task can be completed."

                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Specific deliverables expected from this task."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [

                },

              "metrics": {

                        "type": "number",

                      }
                    },
                    "required": [

                "type": "string",
                "description": "When this decomposition was last modified."
              },

                "type": "string",
                "description": "Version of this decomposition."
              }

            "required": [

              "decomposition"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }

        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__recursive_thinking",
          "description": "Applying recursive strategies to solve problems with base and recursive cases, including optimizations.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "problem": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A clear and comprehensive description of the problem to be solved recursively."
              },
              "problemId": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A unique identifier for this recursive problem analysis."
              },
              "domain": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "The domain or field this problem belongs to (e.g., 'algorithms', 'data structures')."
              },
              "baseCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the base case."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that defines when this base case applies."
                    },
                    "solution": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The direct solution for this base case."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Time/space complexity of solving this base case."
                    },
                    "examples": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Concrete examples of inputs that trigger this base case."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "condition",
                    "solution"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The base cases that terminate the recursion."
              },
              "recursiveCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "id": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "A unique identifier for the recursive case."
                    },
                    "condition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The condition that defines when this recursive case applies."
                    },
                    "decomposition": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the problem is broken down into smaller subproblems."
                    },
                    "recombination": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the solutions to subproblems are combined."
                    },
                    "reductionFactor": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How much the problem size is reduced in each recursive call."
                    },
                    "examples": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Concrete examples of inputs that trigger this recursive case."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "condition",
                    "decomposition",
                    "recombination"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "The recursive cases that break down the problem."
              },
              "terminationConditions": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "All conditions under which the recursion will terminate."
              },
              "complexityAnalysis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "timeComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The time complexity of the recursive solution (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(2^n)')."
                  },
                  "spaceComplexity": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                  },
                  "maxStackDepth": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                  },
                  "worstCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                  },
                  "bestCaseInput": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                  }
                },
                "required": [
                  "timeComplexity",
                  "spaceComplexity"
                ],
                "additionalProperties": false,
                "description": "Detailed complexity analysis of the recursive solution."
              },
              "optimizations": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "technique": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The optimization technique (e.g., 'memoization', 'tail recursion')."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Description of how the optimization works."
                    },
                    "complexityImprovement": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "How the optimization improves complexity."
                    },
                    "tradeoffs": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Trade-offs introduced by this optimization."
                    },
                    "implementation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Implementation details or pseudocode for the optimization."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "technique",
                    "description"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Possible optimizations for the recursive solution."
              },
              "iterativeAlternatives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "approach": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "The iterative approach (e.g., 'bottom-up dynamic programming', 'stack-based iteration')."
                    },
                    "description": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Detailed description of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "advantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Advantages of the iterative approach over recursion."
                    },
                    "disadvantages": {
                      "type": "array",
                      "items": {
                        "type": "string"
                      },
                      "description": "Disadvantages of the iterative approach."
                    },
                    "complexity": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "timeComplexity": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The time complexity of the recursive solution (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(2^n)')."
                        },
                        "spaceComplexity": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The space complexity including call stack (e.g., 'O(n)', 'O(log n)')."
                        },
                        "maxStackDepth": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The maximum depth of the recursion stack."
                        },
                        "worstCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to worst-case performance."
                        },
                        "bestCaseInput": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "Description of input that leads to best-case performance."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [
                        "timeComplexity",
                        "spaceComplexity"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false,
                      "description": "Complexity analysis of the iterative solution."
                    },
                    "implementation": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Pseudocode or implementation details."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "approach",
                    "description",
                    "advantages",
                    "disadvantages"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Alternative iterative solutions."
              },
              "stackOverflowRisk": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "low",
                  "medium",
                  "high"
                ],
                "description": "Risk of stack overflow for typical inputs."
              },
              "inputSizeLimit": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Practical limit on input size before stack overflow."
              },
              "tailRecursionOptimizable": {
                "type": "boolean",
                "description": "Whether the recursion can be optimized with tail recursion."
              },
              "invariants": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Properties that remain true throughout the recursive calls."
              },
              "testCases": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "object",
                  "properties": {
                    "input": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Description of the test input."
                    },
                    "expectedOutput": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Expected output for this input."
                    },
                    "reasoning": {
                      "type": "string",
                      "description": "Why this test case is important."
                    }
                  },
                  "required": [
                    "input",
                    "expectedOutput"
                  ],
                  "additionalProperties": false
                },
                "description": "Key test cases for validating the recursive solution."
              },
              "recursionPattern": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "linear",
                  "binary",
                  "tree",
                  "mutual",
                  "indirect",
                  "nested"
                ],
                "description": "The pattern of recursion used."
              },
              "similarProblems": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Other problems that use similar recursive patterns."
              },
              "learningObjectives": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "What can be learned from this recursive analysis."
              },
              "commonMistakes": {
                "type": "array",
                "items": {
                  "type": "string"
                },
                "description": "Common mistakes when implementing this recursive solution."
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "problem",
              "baseCases",
              "recursiveCases",
              "terminationConditions"
            ],
            "additionalProperties": false
          }
        },
        {
          "name": "mcp__thinking-patterns__scientific_method",
          "description": "Formal hypothesis testing and experimentation following the scientific method.",
          "parameters": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "stage": {
                "type": "string",
                "enum": [
                  "observation",
                  "question",
                  "hypothesis",
                  "experiment",
                  "analysis",
                  "conclusion",
                  "iteration"
                ],
                "description": "The current stage in the scientific inquiry process."
              },
              "observation": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "An initial observation that sparks inquiry (e.g., 'The new feature has lower engagement than expected')."
              },
              "question": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "A specific question that arises from the observation (e.g., 'Why is user engagement low?')."
              },
              "hypothesis": {
                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "statement": {
                    "type": "string",

                          "type": "string",
                          "enum": [
                            "independent",
                            "dependent",
                            "controlled",
                            "confounding"
                          ],
                          "description": "The role of the variable in the experiment. Independent: the one you change. Dependent: the one you measure. Controlled: the ones you keep constant."
                        },
                        "operationalization": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "A precise description of how the variable will be measured or manipulated (e.g., 'Latency measured as Time to First Byte in ms', 'Conversion measured by sign-ups per 1000 visitors')."

                      },
                      "required": [
                        "name",
                        "type"
                      ],
                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },

                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"

                    "description": "Any conditions assumed to be true for the hypothesis to hold (e.g., 'Users notice button size')."

                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for tracking this specific hypothesis."

                    "type": "number",
                    "description": "A prior confidence score (0-1) in the hypothesis before testing.",
                    "minimum": 0,
                    "maximum": 1
                  },

                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The specific area of study or context of the hypothesis (e.g., 'UI/UX Optimization')."
                  },

                  },

                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "A list of IDs of competing or alternative hypotheses."

                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of a previous, broader hypothesis that this one refines."

                  "status": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "enum": [

                      "testing",

                      "refuted",
                      "refined"

                "required": [

                  "assumptions",

                  "iteration",

                "description": "The formal hypothesis being investigated."

                "type": "object",
                "properties": {
                  "design": {
                    "type": "string",

                  },
                  "methodology": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The step-by-step procedure for conducting the experiment."
                  },
                  "predictions": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "object",
                      "properties": {
                        "if": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific condition or action to be taken in the experiment (e.g., 'If we decrease the button size by 50%')."
                        },
                        "then": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "The specific, measurable outcome expected if the hypothesis is true (e.g., 'then the user conversion rate will drop by at least 5%')."
                        },
                        "else": {
                          "type": "string",
                          "description": "An alternative outcome, which might support a competing hypothesis (e.g., 'else the conversion rate will remain unchanged')."
                        }
                      },
                      "required": [

                        "then"

                      "additionalProperties": false
                    },
                    "description": "The specific, testable predictions derived from the hypothesis."
                  },
                  "experimentId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A unique identifier for this specific experiment."
                  },
                  "hypothesisId": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "The ID of the hypothesis this experiment is designed to test."
                  },
                  "controlMeasures": {
                    "type": "array",
                    "items": {
                      "type": "string"
                    },
                    "description": "Measures taken to prevent confounding variables from influencing the results (e.g., 'Ensuring both user groups have similar demographics')."
                  },
                  "results": {
                    "type": "string",
                    "description": "A summary of the raw data or findings from the experiment."
                  },
                  "outcomeMatched": {
                    "type": "boolean",
                    "description": "A flag indicating whether the results matched the 'then' part of the prediction."

                  "nextSteps": {

                  "predictions",
                  "experimentId",

Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with \"only core types\" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered.               "rrule": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: \"DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1\""
              },

Analyzing the OpenSSH server configuration is required to determine potential conflicts.

The plan is to restrict the OpenSSH server rule, so port 22 is only reachable from the specified Tailscale, WSL2/Hyper-V, and localhost addresses. The next step is to examine how to include IPv6 localhost address in the command since the supplied example lacks it.


Testing firewall rules with and without the IPv6 localhost address is needed. The interface profiles for Tailscale and WSL will influence the correct rule. Observed that the Windows user's SSH public key already exists. Checking for the presence of a passphrase on the private key, as this could impact authentication and configuration steps.
```
